The quality of the wine in business class has been reduced from nice Loire, South African or Aussie quality wines, to cheap plonk. Makes no sense. The quality of the food is utterly disgusting. I'm not kidding here. Check the photo of the business class vegetarian meal that I uploaded with this review. Twice they have served me this POW camp slop in business class. Defies all expectations. No accompaniments, no chutney, or sauces. Just brown slop in white rice. What I don't understand is why they are so gung-ho on cost cutting while passenger numbers and revenue are at an all time high. They are cutting their own throats because carriers like Qatar are still offering really great quality service. In fact (and I never thought I would think this) Saudia business class beats Emirates on food quality. (Actually, if you look at the photo of my business class meal, everyone beats that). Emirates customer service is now more concerned with revenue retention than with fulfilling the ticket terms, and can be quite combative. I have noticed that changing a "Flex Plus" ticket, despite being fully changeable always attracts a fare change, even when the original class of ticket if still available to buy in Emirates.com. I had such a fight with them I refunded the entire Flex Plus ticket and rebought the travel in my new date at the lower price I don't know what happening, I have a real soft spot for Emirates. At one time they set the bar for quality, but that's not true anymore and it makes me really sad.

author: Esther Novukela
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   I had a flight from Cairo to Dubai on 25 December at 12h30. The flight was initially delayed and we only boarded at 2pm. We then sat in the aircraft until just before 5pm until they eventually told us to disembark. We then went to baggage collection where most of us waited at least 2 hours for our luggage to arrive. I then waited in a line for another 1 and a half hours to book a new ticket. When booking the new ticket I then informed them my previous flight I had booked the vegan option as I've been strictly vegan for 5 years. They couldn't promise me anything but they said they'd try put the request in as I couldn't adjust it on my app with the flight being canceled. On the flight there were zero vegan options and all I could eat after 20+ hours of travel stress was black tea and some fruit pieces. Furthermore, my skyrewards number never works and I have been unable to accumulate points every time I fly. In addition, I had to purchase my own wifi plan to let friends and family know I finally was safely on my way to Dubai. This has been the worst travel experience for me. Hungry, tired and severely inconvenienced.

author: Judy Godlieb
review_text: Not Verified |  I had the most horrible experience on Emirates Flight # EK 27 . I had already arrived from Colombo to Dubai on EK649 at least they were courteous and friendly. My connecting flight from Dubai to Glasgow was a nightmare. I had booked a diabetic meal and imagine I got the meal minus water. I needed to take my meds and numerous requests were ignored by very arrogant flight attendants specially one of them on this particular flight. After two and a half hours I received 1 cup of water . I was extremely thirsty and dehydrated and when I asked if I could have a bottle of water she curtly replied they do not have bottled water. She took off before I could ask for another cup of water. However passengers seated in front of me were served with water and juice . This didn't solve my problem as I just couldn't get a juice or water at that moment. After about another hour I kept buzzing for a flight attendant and no one came . When the 2nd meal was served I received a small bottle of water and by then I was feeling dehydrated. I'm 63 and not in the best of health . Is this fair? I have lodged a complaint with Emirates and I'm waiting for the response they say they will send me.  Unfortunately I have a return flight from Glasgow to Dubai and Dubai to Colombo and I feel violated and traumatized to think of what to expect . One thing for sure is I will never fly Emirates again. I'm just disgusted. That long walk from terminal to terminal and then taking a bus or the train is equally insane. I paid for Marhaba meet and greet service since I know with mobility issues I would miss the flight. Thankfully the Marhaba service lady was an Angel and so helpful something that the arrogant flight stewardess could learn. It doesn't cost anything to be nice. This was a long haul flight and I would have expected water to be provided in unlimited quantity. Shame on you Emirates. So much for your so called service you boast about. I'm done. I was going to see my 6 year old grandson after 5 years in Scotland and what should have been a happy journey was a nightmare. Unfortunately I have to go again via the same route on this heartless airline. Never again will I take that risk. I have flown Emirates prior and those short flights were so delightful. Not anymore .

author: L Almulla
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | As a frequent flyer with Emirates, I’ve always admired the airline's reputation for exceptional service, but my recent experience in Economy has left me deeply disheartened by the stark disparity in treatment between Business and Economy class passengers. Throughout the flight, it felt as though Economy passengers were treated as an afterthought. It took an excessive amount of time to receive any service, even something as simple as water, despite pressing the call button multiple times. On one occasion, I got up to stretch my legs and was approached by a flight attendant asking if I needed help. When I explained I was just trying to get some movement, I was told to return to my seat and wait for 10 minutes until service was completed. The tone and response felt dismissive and unnecessary. Another unsettling moment occurred when I pressed the service button. A flight attendant walked past me, nodded in acknowledgment, but didn’t stop. When she finally returned, she explained she had been “counting.” While I appreciate that tasks need to be completed, ignoring a passenger’s request and providing such a response felt dismissive and unprofessional. The final incident left me utterly shocked. While refilling my water bottle, another flight attendant accidentally spilled water all over my leg. Instead of a genuine apology or assistance, his response was, “I couldn’t see.” It’s difficult to understand how such carelessness and lack of attentiveness can happen on an airline that prides itself on excellence. As someone who has experienced the polished and attentive service in Business Class, the treatment in Economy was a glaring contrast. It felt as though Economy passengers were not afforded the basic courtesy or care expected from Emirates. While I understand there are differences in service levels between classes, this experience lacked the professionalism and warmth that should be standard across all cabins. I sincerely hope Emirates addresses these inconsistencies. Loyal customers, regardless of class, deserve better treatment and respect.

author: N Siotto
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Outbound I flew Business and inbound was Economy. In comparison with other airlines I have enjoyed the Economy class more than the Business. I was lucky that no one was sitting next to me. The A380 passenger experience is awesome. Nice inflight crew. Decent catering. Unparalleled entertainment. Good comfort. When flying Economy Class, Emirates for me is my preferred choice.

author: Sanjeev Pinjala
review_text: Not Verified |  Worst experience I had with Emirates. I wasn't able to recline my seat on my final flight with Emirates. The airline is declining year over year. Never again Emirates.

author: M Mahrun
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Travelled home on Emirates from Bangkok to Manchester via Dubai, and both these flights had some issues. EK 377 from BKK to DXB  was ok overall. However the standard of the 1st meal served from BKK was very disappointing. Whilst I appreciate this was a 0200 departure from BKK, something a little more substantial in terms of meal would have been appreciated. A little bag of caramel popcorn (as nice as it was) and a drink is simply unacceptable for the high price of the ticket paid. The french toast on the second meal service was soggy and more like a bread pudding, and the Pineapple and Papaya Compote did not taste either, and just looked like pureed fruit slapped onto the dish. Otherwise, no other comments, as the service was ok, and the flight into Dubai was on time. EK21 from DXB to MAN on time but main issue is around meals. Once the cabin crew came to serve breakfast, they already had ran out of the main Omelette dish stating 'everyone wanted this' - how can this always happen? This is very disappointing. Otherwise as from BKK, service ok - but nothing to write home about. Baggage reclaim at MAN was very slow - again reinforces the need to urgently close Terminal 1 ASAP and move to new terminal. I like Emirates - but they have a rival in Qatar Airways that I may consider the next time I fly to Thailand.

author: Mo Ghoorun
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | Travelled from Manchester to Kuala Lumpur with Emirates. The check in process at Manchester was ok - but could be smoother (Self-Check In was ok, but could not print boarding pass). The experience at Manchester Airport however was very chaotic with boarding taking place from Gate 20 as the plane was on a Remote Stand and needed bus transfer to the aircraft. Poor communication between ground staff noted, and passengers were just choosing to board when they desired - not taking notice of staff. Flight delayed for one hour from Manchester - they need to close Terminal 1 ASAP as it is chaotic! The flights themselves were ok. Food was good, and the cabin crew appeared rather lacklustre and not very friendly on the MAN-DXB Sector. This was much improved from DXB - KUL Seats ok - but passengers pushing seats right back when eating is a concern.
route: Manchester to Kuala Lumpur via Dubai

author: C Hoffmann
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | Given all the hype about their first class it was not worth the cost over business class. Service was good but the second leg was somewhat ruined by two kids running up and down the aisle and showering the floor with pop corn. Yes this is the responsibility of the parents but aircrew should have said something. Overall staff were more consistent and visible than when flying business but polish was lacking, example when asking for a glass of the white Burgundy by name you had to show them the picture on the wine list. Yes it’s the little things but that’s what you fly first. Same goes for the quality of food which other than the caviar was ok but lacked the extra that you expect. Airport transfer to the airport in Singapore went well, however Emirates cancelled it for Munich which led to a long wait at the airport until they eventually sorted it by reimbursing the cost of a Taxi. This was a once in a lifetime treat and it failed to deliver. In business on the A380 the offer a good product let’s see how they do when they reconfigure the 777 but we won’t do first again.

author: Said Rouini
review_text: Not Verified | I would like to share my negative experience with Emirates, as I believe they are scammers. I requested a refund for my return ticket from China to Tunis, dated December 29, 2022. Despite sending several emails, I have not received any response. Recently, I visited the Emirates Airlines office in Shanghai. The lady working there was very kind and promised to try contacting the Dubai office to process my refund. Indeed, I received an email (from a no-reply address) after 15 days stating that they had refunded me an amount of 100 Tunisian dinars, which is roughly $35. I sent another inquiry through their website (as no email address was available), filing a complaint on November 15, 2024. I explained that I paid more than 6,300 Tunisian dinars for two one-way tickets and one return ticket. Today, November 27, 2024, I received a system-generated email (from a no-reply address) stating the following: “After reviewing your ticket, we found that it has already been refunded, and no further refund is due. If you require further information or assistance regarding this refund, please visit the website to check our Help section, where you can find contact details for your local Emirates office or fill out a support request form.

author: T Hoyle
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   I’ve written a separate review of the excellent seat 68K but the same cannot really be said of the airline. Economy was pretty crammed and crew made little to no effort to go out of their way. No regular trolley service. No attention to detail. The most shocking thing was the airline’s refusal to board parents with young children first: in fact they actually sent one couple with a baby and toddler to the back of the line. In 50 years of flying I’ve never seen any airline do that, even the rubbish ones. I fly with Qatar and Singapore and there is no way Emirates are anywhere near their standard.

author: Ross Clark
review_text: Not Verified | Basically, what wasn't to like? Positives include the A380 for three of the sectors, and on the return leg, Premium Economy between AKL and DXB, which was excellent. The extra room it added was well worth the additional expense, and top marks for both the seating and the customer service. On the DXB-AKL and DXB-GLA legs (GLA used because EDI not convenient; no extra cost), the economy product on the A380 was well worth it. Could do better: the B777 product is quite cramped by comparison (10-across, not recommended, but only on one shorter leg) and its IFE is tired, even before it is compared with the equivalent service on the A380. EK is working towards introducing A350s on the EDI sector and they can't come soon enough. Finally, the checkins at both EDI and AKL were very quick; opening "early" (four hours or so) does make life a lot easier.

author: Maxim Raya
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   My girlfriend and I boarded the flight EK085 as planned. As my girlfriend had indigestion problems in the morning, we asked for an extra waste bag just in case. The crew then told us we need her to get checked by a doctor at the plane's entrance to make sure she can fly, but instead they offboarded us without actually doing the professional medical checkup by the doctors that they called to the plane. We had then to get a certificate that she's clear to fly, which the doctor gave right away because her condition was absolutely fine. As a result, we wasted a work day each and had to pay the hotel at Dubai airport out of our pocket. I had never experienced this level of deceit, disrespect and mistreatment from any airline before. This is not the behavior I would expect from a respectable business. My girlfriend was fit to fly, as confirmed by the doctor literally 10 mins after we had been deplaned.  I'll never fly this airline again.

author: B Mendy
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | We travelled back from Dubai to Birmingham, due to weather conditions the flight took us to Manchester airport. In Manchester they made us to wait more than 5 hours without providing proper infomration. After waiting 5 hours they asked to exit in Manchester airport. They arranged bus service and asked people to take a private taxi and submit for reimburse. We were waiting in queue for bus, but their staff came to us and asked us to take a cab and submit for reimburment as we had a 1 year old baby and it was raining. I showed them putting my destination price it is costing. They told yes it will be reimburse, you just need to submit a complaint. We raised a complaint and now they are not returing money. They are straight away declaing and they dont have proper call service or any other way to reach out to them. Now I am realizing they lied us to reduce the crowd. If something happens ever with anyone, please dont listen them else you will not get your money back. Better take a email confirmation or video recording as proof. Not sure if that even works to get the refund.

author: L Nair
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | The boarding process quite lengthy and felt that it could have been more efficient. The crew member seems not willing to assist me even on small issues and requests. I found this to be quite disappointing, as the level of service I received did not meet my expectations. I understand that cabin crew members have many responsibilities during a flight, but I believe that it's important for them to be approachable and willing to help passengers when possible. One aspect of the flight that I particularly enjoyed was the food. I found the meal options to be varied and flavorful, and the presentation was attractive and appealing.

author: Marie Menere
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | Very disappointing service - I found the staff very unfriendly, incompetent and rude. Apart from the air hostess dropping a carton of orange juice on me, the air steward shouted aggressively for me to ‘SIT DOWN’ while I was in the toilet queue - while some were allowed to go through. There is a massive drop in the service standard. Compared to other airline's the service on Emirates is very poor, Better options out there.

author: E Waldenai
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Emirates offers an entertainment system that is unmatched with an extensive selection of movies, TV shows, and music. The high-definition screens and user-friendly interface made for a very enjoyable viewing experience. The crew was attentive, professional, and genuinely friendly. The food on Emirates was excellent, exceeding my expectations.  Beverage options were abundant, with a fine selection of juices, soft drinks, wines, and other choices. One particular crew member stood out to me during this journey. Although she is relatively new to her role, her level of professionalism and service was outstanding. Her attention to detail, efficiency, and positive energy set her apart.  I look forward to flying with Emirates again, and I highly recommend this airline.

author: Travis Myoba
review_text: Not Verified | Emirates Airlines is "Mr. Has-Been" Many factors can influence one's satisfaction with an airline, e.g. cabin staff service, seat comfort, food, inflight entertainment, etc. But for me there's one primary factor that determines my satisfaction - on-time arrival. If the flight is 3 or 5 hour late, no food service and no inflight entertainment system would make up for it. When I fly somewhere, I have people waiting for me on the other side, or I have meetings to attend. And when the airline fails to arrive on time, as is nowadays usually the case with Emirates, no smile with "I'm sorry" from the air hostess makes up for it. Over the past few years, Emirates has had an amazing record of disappointing me in the punctuality aspect. Once a great airline, Emirates has been in decline over the past ten (or so) years. This, I suspect, started when they entered into an alliance with Qantas in 2013. Instead of helping the declining and money-losing Aussie carrier, Emirates Airlines has been contaminated by Qantas' monopoly attitude and public service mentality. As I am not seeing any prospects of improvement at Emirates, I will now have to change carriers. My advice to other passengers is: if inflight entertainment is your top priority - fly Emirates. If you want to arrive on time - don't.

author: Justin Curtis
review_text: Not Verified | This past week we flew from JFK to Tanzania by way of Dubai. The first leg of the trip we upgraded to premium economy, which was great. On the way home, we flew economy. We had requested gluten free food and were provided it on the way to Tanzania, but only 1/2 of us received it on the way home. At Dubai during our 5 hour layover, we attempted to speak to customer service, but the agent on site was not helpful. In fact, airline security was at the help desk and seemingly tried to prevent us from even speaking with the agent regarding upgrading and the issue with our food. After speaking with the help desk, we were advised we likely would not be receiving gluten free food on the 14 hour flight back to JFK despite the multi hour layover. Additionally, we were advised no additional premium economy seats were available for upgrade. While boarding, multiple other guests upgraded at the gate before us, so there were additional upgrades available, or at least so it seemed. We were not happy with our experience with this airline.
route: New York to Dar es Salaam via Dubai

author: D Hayes
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   The service of cabin crew is extremely hit and miss, with some staff being fantastic and others barely making an effort to serve food and snacks to passengers - we had family sitting on one side of the cabin offered way more choices than family sitting on the other side of the cabin, sometimes having to flag down cabin crew just to be served. Also, Emirates has no clue how to organise passenger seating, with our underaged child separated from the rest of the family and placed in an aisle seat several rows away from us purely because another passenger had paid to have an aisle seat, and ground staff said they couldn't change the other passenger to the aisle seat our child was assigned. We had to depend on the kindness of the other passenger, who when told the situation by us, agreed to the swap as it was essentially for the same seat she had paid for. And we were not the only family this happened to, multiple families were separated from underage children. Finally, Emirates damaged one of our suitcases beyond repair or use, and it has taken them 9 months to process compensation. The compensation they have offered is ridiculous - $100 for a suitcase that cost $400 to purchase because product costs "depreciate". We are really unhappy with Emirates and will not be flying with them ever again.

author: Ranjit Mander
review_text: Not Verified | WIFI enabled but just didn't work. Awful experience both ways LHR to Dubai on their A380. Rung up customer services 2 days before departure to get an idea of how full the flight was and was informed it was only 50% full. Called again a few hours before departure and again told the same. Got on the flight and it was full! I mean why would they need to lie? Then WIFI was not working so couldn't even use that. A new A380 plane and WIFI not working?  To top it off the plane was over an hour late departing. Then on return again plane late and again WIFI not working - but took my money as I paid for the full WIFI. And the flight again delayed! Been checking historical flights and for some reason all the Emirates flights to and from London over the last week or so have all been delayed for over an hour. Be careful, they encourage you to become a Sky Rewards Member and you can benefit from free WIFI! Why when it doesn't even work? And the complimentary WIFI is only for messaging, not for general Internet which is $16 for the full flight Dubai to London. Rubbish airline and missed 2 full days of work because of no WIFI. As someone who frequently travels on business I need to find an airline that I can do work on and has reliable WIFI long haul - Emirates is useless and doesn't work at all. Won't be using Emirates again. The air stewardess was awesome, very apologetic - I mean it's not her fault but she handled it very well.

author: Sanjeev Pinjala
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   I flew with Emirates from Hyderabad to Washington Dulles via Dubai. I didn't have a great time, legroom wasn't great, and my recliner wasn't functioning. Hyderabad was a pain as there was a crowd at the Emirates gate. I can see that this airline is declining year over year. It is time to move onto another airline.

author: Chris Campbell
review_text: Not Verified | My parents and I travelled to Lisbon via Dubai on the A380 and 777-300ER and service was very good, food was tasty and economy on the A380 and 777-300er and 777-200er was pretty good. And we travelled home from Barcelona via Dubai to Perth on 777-200LR and A380 and service was the same. My overall experience with Emirates being my first time was great and I would recommend them for overseas travel. This was my first time travelling on the amazing A380 and it was great to fly on.

author: S Baines
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   I've done 4 very long distance flights with Emirates and I have to say I'm the most disappointed with the cabin staff service. Many of them appeared really moody or even mean on all 4 flights. They always seemed annoyed and unimpressed when requesting their service for anything. I assume they're just taught to be lovely to business and first class customers and economy doesn't matter? It's just so odd. Are they extremely stressed or something? Even the cheapest airline staff has been much nicer to me every single time. I really wouldn't call myself a difficult customer - one time I asked if the staff could turn down the fan a few rows down mine because I couldn't reach and the air was making me freezing cold to which the cabin crew replied "Okay but I can't reach it so I have to ask the people in that row, next time just ask them yourself". What's that about? Then they also forgot to take my partners food tray and when they were coming around I told them about it and was met with "Oh... okay". Not a sorry or anything at all. I thought they would be trained to provide an overall better experience and interaction. Also I haven't pressed the button for staff service many times, but out of the times I have, they responded in only about 30% of the cases. Overall I'm absolutely disappointed with the cabin crew. Otherwise, the food was quite nice, the Internet was unreachable most of the time, plane relatively clean.

author: Sanjeev Pinjala
review_text: Not Verified |  I had a horrible experience with Emirates as they mistreated me aboard all 4 flights. I was yelled by a flight attendant on my first flight just for waiting to use the restroom. I also had a bad time in Dubai during a layover. It was so cold inside the cabin, I never felt that cold in a plane before. I see that Emirates is declining in their service. It is time to move onto another airline.
route: Washington Dulles to Hyderabad via Dubai

author: Wayne Good
review_text: Not Verified |   Business Class from Barcelona (using miles) to Dubai and Premium Economy to Auckland. Lounge in Barcelona busy, however a good selection of food and beverages, and most importantly a good shower. Business class very comfortable, good food and attentive service. I do like the bar area. A nice place to stretch one’s legs. 4 hour layover in Dubai, spent in lounge in Terminal c then Terminal b, which is the better lounge. Premium Economy to Auckland. Wonderful service, from a charming young lady on my aisle. I like that my status with Emirates is always acknowledged by the crew. A nice touch. Good food, and I found plenty to watch on the entertainment. Delayed by 1 hour in Dubai, so arrived an hour late into Auckland. Emirates is my airline of choice.

author: S Meade
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Mistreat unaccompanied minor passengers. Travellers can only obtain VISAS through only one visa provider. We followed correct process for visa application and at the airport confirmed with departures that visa was valid. The unaccompanied child was permitted to board the Emirates flight, I still paid $100 additional for unaccompanied minor service. The entire time I checked with all stakeholders could this child travel unaccompanied to Dubai on her own. Every single time I was told yes. Emirates sold me the ticket, Emirates sold me the unaccompanied minor package but now are not accepting responsibility! Upon arrival in Dubai the minor was aggressively treated by immigration, detained for 24 hours and deported back home. The child was not permitted to cross the border to visit her grandmother residing in Dubai. Now the airline claims that the grandmother could have applied for a different visa at the Dubai airport. So they won't allow the child to leave with the grandmother but they will allow the grandmother to apply for another visa? Flawed policy. That is all these greedy airlines care about. The child was detained and while her physical needs were taken care of, she has been left psychologically traumatized. Received few meal vouchers while detained.

author: Ted Thacker
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   I got off my flight and immediately realised i had left behind my wireless headphones. I tried to go back but was denied. I went straight to Emirates lost and found hoing to get some service as a premium customer. Instead i got send us an email. I held my ground and was fobbed off by being assured plane would be cleaned within four hours and they would send them on to me in Singapore my next stop. Guess what not found even though i gave them my exact seat and they could not care less. This is now a number of poor Emirates customer service experiences for me, so never again will I fly Emirates unless i have no other options.

author: Dinesh Navaratne
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   This was my first time with the airline. Emirates food was amazing! The staff was very professional and helpful. I would fly again with them—I have no regrets about the money we spent.

author: Wayne Good
review_text: Not Verified | Travel does not get any better than Emirates A380, especially on a 17 hour flight. Premium Economy Auckland to Dubai. Really comfortable seat, good food and service. Had a good solid 8 1/2 hours sleep. Although the IFE is vast, I find the choice for me is limited. I’m just being picky I guess. The Business lounge in Terminal C is woeful. I will do a separate review. Dubai to Barcelona I used points to upgrade to Business. Fabulous. Very comfortable seat, charming service and good food. I love the bar area. I fly to Europe 2 to 3 times a year and always use Emirates. They slightly more expensive, but worth it.

author: Suhail Kazim
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   The flight was choc a bloc full in every class. The cabin manager Mohamed was very efficient but the lady serving my section was definitely not in her right mood. Meals were very disappointing, to say the least. Service from Mpohamed was exceptional!

author: Suhail Kazim
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | The check-in staff was terribly slow and repetitive in her questions. We spent over an hour completing it. The Emirates lounge was very good and in fact that was the only proper meal we had. The male staff at the reception was very very helpful. In flight, it was an AWFUL experience. The staff could not cope with the full flight and dinner was served 2.5 hours after take off. Food was appalling!! Emirates catering leaves a lot to desire.

author: Mehdi Benali
review_text: Not Verified | Emirates used to be good. Their standards have clearly dropped while their prices have increased. I have been flying with them for 10 years and never did I get upgraded! I did not mind flying economy but now, the food is really bad, customer service is terrible. Not the best company out there anymore.

author: Z Khizer
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Boarding was a mess, I blame Lisbon Airport for such a disastrous management. Plane was clean though seats were showing the age (old faded fabric). Took-off on time. IFE was ok nothing too impressive the way they advertise it. Emirates meal portion and quality is the best. I had the best beef lasagna. Dessert, bread, etc were also excellent. Generous with the drinks. Snack was served before landing, just a simple cheese sandwich. The crew on board wasn't too interactive. Only saw them during the meal services and that's about it.

author: V Eni
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Emirates did not live up to its reputation. On two of the four legs they ran out of food options. The meals were only served 2-3 hours into the flight. The worst happened on the last leg between DXB and JHB. We were seated between 4 drunk passengers (2 unrelated to the other 2) who’s behavior was shocking and filthy to say the least. The staff didn’t really handle the situation well and it seemed like they rather chose not to have any confrontation. Quite frankly, we were surprised those passengers were even allowed to board since they were already clearly drunk at the airport. In fact, 2 of them seemed to be somewhat drugged as well. The other two drunk passengers made the flight really uncomfortable for those around them, even indecently exposing themselves. We were just grateful that they did not become aggressive, posing a risk to smooth flight operations. The cabin supervisor’s judgement was poor and the cabin crew did nothing to rectify the situation, even after being alerted to the problem. In fact, they served 2 of them more alcohol which was absolutely the wrong thing to do. We have to say that we have never experienced such poor service and unprofessionalism before.  Emirates need to up their game. At the moment, Qatar Airways definitely have the upper hand.

author: Loay Osman
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   I flew a return trip DXB-LIS-DXB I used my miles to upgrade to business class on the outbound journey which was a very nice experience a morning flight with flat bed seat lovely crew and amazing service . On the return they surprised me on boarding with an upgrade to business class. Even though it was the middle seat, it didn’t bother me. They provided bulgari amenities kit and mattress and cover. After a delicious meal I had a 5 hrs sleep as it was an over night flight.

author: Vishesh Tyagi
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   We were 2 people travelling together and on the Dubai-Boston sector, the armrests on the seats allotted just wouldn’t stay up. We highlighted it to the crew before takeoff and they sent a technician to check. The technician came, saw it from a distance and went back saying he’ll send someone else. The flight took off, no one came. Highlighted to the crew again - they said, “Our technician came but you refused to get up from your seat and let him check. And we can’t help you now”.  It was a 14 hour horrendous experience and deficiency in service, coupled with a lie and blaming it on us. It was physically painful with the armrest pushing on the shoulder for 14 hours and a mental agony at such service and behaviour by the crew.

author: Rolf Welgraven
review_text: Not Verified |   First time flying Emirates, was expecting a lot because this airline has a good name. Unfortunately the facts are different. Attendants on 3 of the 4 legs a have flown with them look as they are very tired. Making eye contact, heads are turned away, being in the aisle for a short moment, I was literally pushed aside by a staff member walking up and down the aisle. Meal time was too short, 1 time I got my breakfast 30 minutes before landing, 5 minutes later they tried to collect my meal again. The meals itself were overall good and the food was enjoyable. Ground services in Amsterdam and Dubai were accurate and friendly. Overall I booked my next vacation in December and avoided this airline. The feeling I got from Emirates was that I am not welcome and passengers are a burden.

author: T Balmon
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  Ground Staff and Service Failures on Flight EK 354. My carefully planned return trip from UK, with EMIRATES turned into a nightmare due to issues caused by their Dubai ground staff.  Upon checking in Manchester, I was issued a boarding pass for the MAN-DXB and DXB-SIN legs of my journey, with seats allocated according to my pre booking. However, upon reaching Dubai and during check-in, the counter staff took my boarding pass and issued a new one. Initially, I presumed new boarding pass was due to a soiled document and did not notice the seat change as there is no change in flight. To my disappointment, the new seat I was assigned turned out to be directly in front of the toilet onboard. I also sought assistance from cabin crew and online chat services before take-off, but unfortunately, no one helped me. I had specifically opted for an Economy Flex Plus ticket, solely to secure a seat reservation that would allow for a more comfortable journey. The proximity to the restroom doors, with their associated noise, significantly hindered my ability to rest or enjoy the flight services as intended. Furthermore, crew members accessing the overhead luggage bins above my seat at regular intervals further disrupted any chance of relaxation. Additionally, during the meal service, crew members did not lock the lavatory door, causing passengers to enter and exit while I was eating. This forced me to stop my meal. At the end of the journey, the crew sarcastically asked me about my flight experience, despite being well aware of the difficulties I had faced. Emirates' service in 2024 should be considered among the worst. Until today I have not received any reply on my compliant placed with Emirates and their customer service reminded me that it requires 60 days to send a reply. I must tell that compare to past, Emirates service quality are highly deteriorated and no one care of it there.

author: Pak yin Leung
review_text: Not Verified |  The staff are friendly and the seat is comfortable. The air ticket is cheap. There's TV and wifi, there are also a gift for kids too. The services are very great. There are many delicious foods to eat too.

author: Manik Joshi
review_text: Not Verified |   I had a flight in April from Mumbai to Dubai to London. Due to the rains / flood in Dubai flights were getting canceled but Emirates never bothered to inform the passengers. I had to spend 6k (back and forth) on Uber coming from Pune to Mumbai to catch the flight. After I got to the gate they told me the flight was canceled. I was so furious. I asked them why I never got any text or email update and they blamed it on the passengers. So I asked her to verify my phone number. When I got to the airport I checked on the app about the flight details and till that time it showed on time. They never even bothered to change that. Now that I am asking for my refund they are not taking responsibility and returning my money.

author: R Vines
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  It was my first time flying premium economy on Emirates, and I'd happily do it again. The seats were wide, with plenty of legroom, and the food was quite good. Service was also fine. Shame they serve Prosecco and there is very limited choice on wines, but let's skip right past that. Obviously, I'd much rather fly business or first on Emirates, but this was better than the old business class on BA and worth paying to avoid economy.

author: D Mahrin
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  The services on the mentioned sector was pathetic. Dirty Toilets, tissue all around the floor. The meal asked for at the time of booking and paying at least 25% more than other airlines, was not provided. A simple service for lukewarm water was not provided. In flight movies were nothing new or trendy. Overall a very poor performance.

author: H Madasan
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  I have always been flying in Emirates because of their good services but this time we had a very bad experience! The cabin crews were terrible to say the least especially from Dhaka to Dubai. We asked for a Bassinet for the baby a few times but didn't get one. The baby fell asleep and I was holding for about half an hour watering a bassinet still did not get one then I had to speak to one of the cabin crews with a firm tone to get one! They didn't even offer lunch to one of my daughters. When asked, the lady said oh do you want lunch? What do you mean? She is 11 years old and needs food to eat on board, doesn't she? They also didn't give us any baby food either. My boy was hungry and crying. The lady next to me with infants had to share one of her babies food with my boy. When I fed that food to my son, one cabin crew came with some baby food which we didn't ask for saying we ran out of what you asked for. Just terrible! We also noticed in general the cabin crews were unprofessional, careless and ignoring the passengers' requests. It was a terrible experience this time. Hope Emirates read these reviews and take serious actions to improve their services.

author: Patricia Achami
review_text: Not Verified |   I am writing this review to express my profound disappointment and frustration with the service provided by various departments, particularly customer support, following the cancellation of my flight from Vienna to Male last April due to the recent floods in Dubai. While I understand the circumstances surrounding the flight cancellation, the issue lies with the abysmal customer support I have encountered since then. Upon requesting a certificate for insurance purposes, I was informed that I would need to wait 30 days for processing, which I accepted as part of the procedures. However, upon receiving the certificate after the specified period, it was found to be incorrect for both myself and my travel companion. Subsequent attempts to rectify this error have been met with further delays and inefficiencies. Despite being advised to fill out another form for follow-up, it has now been two months since my initial request, and I am still awaiting the correct certificates. The lack of assistance and communication from customer support has been appalling, with promises to escalate the issue to the relevant department unfulfilled and no resolution in sight. As a loyal customer of Emirates, I am deeply dismayed by the subpar level of customer support and service provided in this instance. The unresolved issue with the certificates has also led to a delay in processing my insurance claim, further exacerbating the situation. It is truly disheartening to experience such incompetence and negligence. The disparity between the exceptional flight services and the inadequate customer support is not only disappointing but also unacceptable.

author: M. LaPrairie
review_text: Not Verified | Having flown almost exclusely in business class for work travel paid for by my employer, the thought of 19+ hours in economy class from Delhi to Washington via Dubai filled me with dread. I was pleasantly surprised, however, by EK's economy product. While it is still economy and you can never 'go flat', I found Emirates' economy to be way better than United or Air Canada economy and, overall, offers solid hard and soft products. The seat is a decent size and has good legroom, again, compared to North American carriers. Catering was good with two full meals and a pizza or sandwich snack in between. Meal portions were good with plenty of variety. I was impressed by the 'engineering' of the economy meal tray with every conceivable space used to offer something. Every time I rang the call button, it was answered pleasantly. Washrooms were kept quite clean throughout both sectors. The ICE entertainment system offers tons of options. If paying out of my own pocket, I'd again chose EK economy.

author: J Ali
review_text: Not Verified |   Boarding started on time, the staff were friendly and hospitable despite some challenging behavior from some of the travelers. The cabin was clean and well kept. The food was served on time and was appetizing. The IFE worked well and their library of content was well curated. Overall a good experience.

author: L Berten
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  Emirates provides an option to purchase extra kilograms of luggage before the flight. However, the link they provide does not lead to any option that allows for pre-purchasing luggage. Instead, the link leads to options for seat or class upgrades, food selection, or flight charges. In other words, Emirates takes extra effort to hide the option to buy extra kilograms prior to check-in. Today, I faced an extra charge of £380 because I was not given the option to purchase extra kilograms in advance. I tried searching but could not find the actual link to buy extra luggage. There are much better options to fly. Will not use your bad service next time.

author: H Jalati
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  The economy cabin in this airline is the worst in the world. Very rude flight attendants and crew. They only take care of higher levels, and other passengers, who are the majority of people in flight, are nothing to them. I was the gold member of this airline, and I stopped to fly with them. After 14 years, I tried to gain with minor hope for some changes, but it was worse than before. The crew's attitude on the ground and flights with economic passengers is unbelievable. It seems all of them are trained to deal with economy passengers like this. It is obviously not a chance for all of them to act like this with an insulting attitude.

author: T Mandel
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  No service with customer service has been terrible. They simply do not care about passengers. My sister had to cancel her leg of trip due to a diagnosed blood disorder that was serious enough she could not travel far from her home, fly, sit for long periods etc. While she undergoes series of tests to figure out cause and how to help her, Emirates would not let her cancel her one way, outbound flight. The flight does not leave for 7 months. They feel she can rest up and be healed by the date of departure.  She does have a flexible economy ticket to make the cancellation. They claim medical reasons are not approved reasons for cancellation of most of ticket value. Trying to change the name so i can save the trip and take a friend instead? Nope! Out of the question says Emirates.

author: Chris Greenwood
review_text: Not Verified | My first experience travelling First Class (using Qantas points) was pretty surreal. Having flown the best (and worst) of discount airlines and everything in between, this was something else. Just the sense that you're the only one on board and that you call the shots. It was other-worldly. I drank dom perignon for 7 hours, ate a lot of caviar and chatted to some lovely relaxed staff (after all, they only had four passengers to attend to). The 'suite' was large, comfortable and opulent. Of course it was... Even though it was a 777 (not a 380), there was an absolute sense of luxury. Not sure if I'll ever try/fly first class again, but it was worth the points and a lot of fun.

author: G Meares
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  Decent flights, but unremarkable. Service was polite but disengaged, with little attempt by crew to interact with passengers. Seats were comfortable, with good legroom. I thought the IFE was excellent, with some quality new releases to choose from. The meals were large and generous - I am a Qatar Airways frequent flyer, and the Emirates meals are significantly larger than those on Qatar. However, the alcohol options are far smaller on Emirates, and on both flights I was only offered a drink once per flight. It's been nearly 20 years since I last flew Emirates and feel they have lost their shine; whilst I thought they were decent, I feel they lack the polish and refinement of Qatar.

author: T Katz
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | I fly a lot, but Emirates were my worst experiences ever. Most importantly, 2 out of 2 times I flew with them, I was delayed for multiple hours. The first time it was just sitting on the plane with no AC for 2 hours, and the second was 3+ hours, due to some trivial problem with their cabin lights. That 2nd time I had a connecting flight to catch, and while on board they assured me it would be fine, and while I did make it to the gate while they were still boarding, they refused to board me due to having apparently unilaterally decided to rebook me to a flight 11 hours later, assuming I wouldn't make it. Turns out there were earlier flights, but they wouldn't book me to them due to not codesharing with those airlines. Not only was no compensation offered for this day-long delay, but when I finally booked a separate flight on my own, they wouldn't even refund me, and had me request it on my own online. Overall they just showed 0 willingness to help throughout the entire process, despite it being 100% their fault, for a delay caused by them and between flights both of which they operated. They made it as painful as it possibly could be, every step of the way. Oh, and the flights themselves were also bad - old-looking airplanes, terrible food, and relatively limited entertainment. Emirates might have earned a positive reputation due to their First Class experience, but for Economy flights, it's probably the worst airline I've ever flown.

author: Wayne Good
review_text: Not Verified |   Returning from France, travelling in Economy to Dubai, then Premium Economy from Dubai to Auckland. First row in economy, so no one in front of me.  Service and meals were very good. Only 6 hours over night so decided not to sleep on this sector. Watched a couple of movies. The plane seemed on the older side, so movie selection not as good it seemed. Visited the lounge in Dubai due to my Emirates status, which was very good. Shower very welcome and good coffee. Flight to Auckland in Premium Economy a big step up from Economy. Seat very comfortable with loads of legroom, good recline and leg/foot rest. Slept for about 9 hours out of 15 hours. Service was friendly, professional and thorough buy a charming young British chap called Zak. Meals were delicious, hot towels etc. Entertainment was more extensive, although only watched 1 movie, as I wanted to sleep. Arrived half an hour early in Auckland. First off the plane and land side in less than 30 minutes.

author: R Norton
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | Emirates is plummeting downhill! Business class but no fast track, no lounge, no information, nobody to speak with! Such a shame that what was once a great airline now barely makes ‘good’, and that only because the cabin crew are the best...the rest are simply awful!

author: S Chanon
review_text: Not Verified |   On 3/9/2024, I transferred more than 300,000 points from Chase Ultimate Reward to Emirates Skywards account for First Class miles redemption for a flight from Seattle to Thailand. Shortly after that, Skywards locked my account, indicating it's due to "a routine review." However, after more than a few weeks, my account was still under "a routine review." That's when I started making a call to their customer service, but all they can do is sending an email to the internal team and told me to do the same, which I did ... but no response whatsoever from the internal team. Subsequent calls to the customer services and after hours of explaining, arguing, pleading yield the same outcome (or lack thereof.) The customer service agents were not willing to escalate the issue for us even though they knew that this issue has been going on way longer than their normal timeline. they did not try to help you in any way regardless of how bad the situation is. There was one one time after we pushed so hard to get to talk to their supervisor but even him would not try to help you anyway. Their entire customer service is there just to serve their internal team, not their customers. It has been almost three months now and my account is still under "a routine review". What supposes to be a dream trip has since becomes one of my worst nightmares. The customer service agents said the reward miles are valid for 3 years so nothing to be worried about, but how would it matter if my travel plan window is already passed - and at this rate who knows whether they will complete the "routine review" of my account within 3 years. All I want at this point is for the precious points I have been saving up all these years to go back to my Chase Ultimate Reward account and wake up from this nightmare.

author: K Brouwer
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | I have a business class ticket for 3 flights AMS - SGP (Business Saver) SGP - DBX (Flex Plus)$$ DBX - AMS (Flex Plus)$$ Conditions for Flex plus as per webiste states: "Flex Plus fare A Flex Plus fare is a totally flexible and unrestricted fare". I'm 2 days before first departure. I want to change the 3rd flight. My "Flex Plus" doesn't apply anymore since they will reissue all 2 flights and the first one is Business Saver. They want to charge me 900€ to upgrade the 1st one, then 300€ change fee. In other words, if "any" of your flights is saver, "none of them" are Plus anymore. I feel scammed.

author: Ziauddin Ahmed
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Traveled from Dhaka to Lyon via Dubai in June 2023. Seat quality was average, food was also average, cabin crew were good. Ground services were slow. Flight was not bad but the layover at Dubai Airport was boring.

author: T Keen
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  I’ve flown Emirates a few times. I love the food but the flight attendants on all my flights were unfriendly and rude. Many of them are acting like they are doing us a favor by serving us, even though that’s their job. On May 5, I flew from Tokyo to Dubai and most likely it was my last flight with the Emirates. Especially a flight attendant who was very unfriendly and also skipped our line while serving food. She was unfriendly with everyone.  She seems to be hating her job. Apart from the flight attendants, one other thing I am not happy about is the delays. In my experience, Emirates never departs and arrives on time, there is always a delay.

author: L Mardele
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  I have just collected my bag after a horrendous Emirates flight where the passenger next to me was intoxicated and assaulted me on the flight. The crew had to write a report as she should have not been allowed boarding. My bag is completely soaked through, all contents of the bag is soaking. I spoke to the ground staff and they could offer no help what so ever or a report. Everything is ruined - I am furious, I’ve had no communication regarding my outbound flights that were cancelled due to the storms and now my luggage is ruined. I will never fly Emirates again.

author: Sara Mendez
review_text: Not Verified |   Seats were very comfortable, very polite staff but the food quality has gone down significantly. Tasteless and overcooked. Not what it used to be when it was first launched.

author: F Salih
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  Inbound flight to DXB was 16 years old A6-EWC 777-200 refurbished cabin which is comfortable. Cabin crew reflect good training, collaborative. Food is standard like others, did not use IFE during flight. Connected in Dubai for less than 30 minutes and disembarked to bus then terminal and surprisingly my luggage arrived to terminal destination.

author: M Fuller
review_text: Not Verified |   Emirates left thousands of passengers stranded for up to 3 days in Dubai airport, some with children with no help or explanation. They have no contingency for rain and no interest in human care. They have provided no compensation for the impacted passengers. They claim that missing luggage was also due to the rain, they provide no help when things get tough and I will never be flying with them again. They also required me to fill out a medical form to board and they took zero notice of my one requirement (more drinking water than average) and, despite being able bodied, would not allow me to purchase the bulkhead seats after having spoken to me in person (a fit and healthy 35 year old with just a touch of hydrocephalus) due to the fact, and I’m quoting here I’m “disabled.”

author: F Salih
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  Boarding fast despite seemingly full airplane. FA good and attentive. Departure delayed by 30 minutes. Outdated seat you need to press button 100 times to go to flat. Food quality is average. Internet not working, I have to spend time trying and trying. Bathrooms are clean however it was at the back of the airplane, front bathroom kept for first class, and every time i went i found 3-4 waiting, Toothbrush not available.

author: Tientham Sathientham
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | My friend and I were scheduled to fly from Prague to Bangkok on 18 Apr. The flight was delayed 4 times. We arrived 2.30 hours before departing time. After 1.30 hour wait and 2 very disorganized check-in counter change, the counter stopped taking in passenger. No explanation from the staff. We found out from a fellow passenger that the flight was not confirmed. I tried calling and contacting them online but both channels were too busy. We finally went to talk to the staff who couldn't confirm when we will be flying out. They told us that they could not confirm about our connecting flight in Dubai to Bangkok too. A two-to-three-days wait was probable. We finally had to cancel the flight and bought a new last-minute ticket from Qatar to get back home. We tried to get compensation on extra hotel charge and airfares but the airline is not taking any responsibility. Extremely poor management and definitely no sense of responsibility from the airline.

author: Parimila Sathemany
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  My sister and I travelled to Toronto via KLIA on 20th March 2024. The services were top notch. We travelled by economy class but were treated nicely by the stewardess. The food was great and we were fed quite frequently. When coming back on 4th April, we had a bad experience due to mistake done by Air Canada since we had 2 layovers and one of the layover had to travel via Air Canada.
route: Toronto to Kuala Lumpur via Dubai

author: N Rasakan
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  As someone from the service industry as an Operations Manager, it is rather appalling the standard for this experience. Not only did the person attending our aisle forgotten our drink requests once, but twice! One of which i also have to take the drink order myself. Not only that, the flight attendant didn’t apologise on both occasions which are of different time stamps, that’s a poor representative of the airline and i believe this is rather basic. Moreover and unfortunately, screen on the seat was blank and was requesting assistance to resolve it. Was reassured that it will be troubleshoot in 10-15 minutes. Guess what? Wasn’t resolve throughout the remaining of the flight. And also, i believe it’s basic to walk down the aisle once in awhile at your respective section to check-in with the guests to see everything is alright and needs immediate attention, but am noticing a pattern on both occasions, to and fro Dubai and Singapore. Seems like they only service during food and drinks, then hide back in the staff area.

author: N. Siotto
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  Great airplane, service and staff, especially when flying on the A380 with the bar.  The seat is comfortable, crew is friendly and professional. The aircraft is clean. However the catering is a little disappointing. For such an expensive ticket I was expecting far better to be honest.

author: K Darsen
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  True color of organisation is discovered when time of need arise, and Emirates capability is discovered. Never fly Emirates again, do not recommend anyone to travel on Emirates - you will be left to dry. I checked onto EK421 with a 20 kg checked bag on 18th March from Perth Airport. Arrived at Dubai airport on the 19th morning, as of today after 3 days of being me hostage at Dubai airport - there's no information from Emirates airport staff on anything, no worry about my dietary needs, my medical needs, sorry about my personal & business plan). I am not allowed to access my essential needs & medication from checked-bag and they would not put me on to my next connecting flight. At Dubai Airport Emirates staff directed me and others to continuously watch out for the Gate number on the screen as the flight would be listed there (but they won't tell when), I and others kept waiting for hours for the flight to appear, they appear without gates, stay listed there and then gets canceled. Clearly Emirates are just listing ghost flights so they don't need to provide a hotel. I am now on airport for more than 36 hours, no hotel provided, no vegetarian food available, I now almost three days in the same pair of clothing, and my medication & other essentials are in a checked-in bag that Emirates staff don't even care and tell me anything on when it will be returned to me. Their pretext that this is due to rain is just made up, as of last few days Dubai has returned to normal, for sure essential airport services there shouldn't be hold up and the excuse of weather event is just hiding their lack of management ability.

author: J Darcen
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  Horrible service from start to finish. 6 hours delay. No communication. Unable ground staff and very rude. Lost baggage. I could spend hours making list of the problems. Will definitely change airline.

author: Walid Lahoud
review_text: Not Verified |   After some disruption in Dubai airport due to a storm, Emirates seems not to recover. The situation is getting worse and day by day more flights are cancelled and more luggage lost. Emirates has lost it completely and the management of Emirates is not putting all what it takes to go back on track. After 11 years of flying Emirates as platinum member I am evaluating the possibility of moving to Qatar airways or even Etihad. Emirates has wonderful inflight service but the lack of professionalism of the ground staff is killing the company

author: J Edwards
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | Flights postponed due to weather, spent 4 hours on hold for an agent to rebook flight as we needed to be home on the 20th. Phone number sometimes worked and sometimes didn’t. Called 20 plus times. Headed to airport to speak to an agent in person while on the 4 hour call hold. Finally rebooked to New York but the original ticket was for Miami. Flight is at midnight and the airport wouldn’t let us through the gate so we are spending 6+ hours with no AC in hot conditions and my mum is elderly (70) and not in good health. Also told us that we had to pay our own fare to Miami from New York which cost an additional $800 which they said will not be refunded. Also we were told this at 10:30am when the flight was at 4pm today.

author: Greg Padin
review_text: Not Verified |   Shocking service. I would never recommend this airline. Cancelled flight home and literally left everyone to fend for themselves. Long delays and everyones been messed about. Absolutely diabolical for being such a massive company. Would give 0 stars if allowed. Definitely not travelling with them ever again

author: Debora Paiva Givisiez
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  After the big storm in Dubai, my mother stayed locked in the airplane after landed for 8 hours, no food, no assistance, no information! She is 64 years old, she has problem to walk, I even requested the wheel chair and transfer assistance to take her from one gate to the other. After 8 hours, when they let the passengers out of the plane, she didn’t get any assistance and had to walk a lot, as we know Dubai airport is huge. She lined up for 3 hours to get a new board pass, they gave her a boarding pass for 08:20am on 17/04/24, but it was already 22:10 17/04/24 when they give it to her. She didn’t eat for this whole time. Now they booked her in for on flight at 09:05 on 18/04/24, let’s see. The problem is not rescheduled the flight due the bad weather, the problem was the Emirates didn’t give any assistance to the passengers.
route: Brisbane to Sao Paulo via Dubai

author: S Ahuja
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | We have boarded the flight from BOM to DXB on 04.04.2024 which was late because of a technical issue and the crew doesn't want to work over shift. The said flight reached the next day without any inflight food (BOM-DXB) instead of the same day creating physical harassment, mental harassment and financial losses (hotel & further tour charges got cancelled). Despite having active transit visa your staff kept us waiting for three hours at DXB airport for issuing current transit. My Flight no. EK 0506 which has original time of departure 9.30am (DXB-BOM) has not yet departed (till 10 pm) because of bad weather conditions but flight EK 0502 which has original departure time of 13.00 pm has already reached BOM. How come? It seems EK 0506 is not important, (bad weather is applicable to all flights). This behaviour and approach of Emirates is totally not acceptable & hence we here by demand compensation.

author: Barry Lok
review_text: Not Verified |   On both the outward and return flights, I or my travel partner sat on a broken seat. Yes, we had booked economically, but then you can expect a fully functioning chair, right? Our flight to Bali took more than twenty hours in total. The quality of the chairs was nothing to write home about. We arrived at all destinations broken. I bought a new suitcase in Bali. This one also arrived “broken” at home in Amsterdam. One flight with Emirates was apparently too much for this beautiful suitcase. After some correspondence back and forth with Emirates, the conclusion was that they could not do anything for me and would not take responsibility. My conclusion is therefore to take a look at other companies where service may still be expected. In any case, I won't be booking Emirates again anytime soon. My next flight to Bali is with our KLM. Zowel op de heen- als op de terugvlucht zat ik of mijn reispartner op een kapotte stoel. Ja, we hadden economisch geboekt, maar dan mag je toch wel een volledig functionerende stoel verwachten? Onze vliegreis naar Bali duurde in totaal meer dan twintig uren. De kwaliteit van de stoelen was niet om naar huis te schrijven. Gebroken kwamen we op alle bestemmingen aan. Op Bali had ik een nieuwe koffer gekocht. Deze kwam ook “gebroken aan” thuis in Amsterdam. Één vlucht met Emirates was blijkbaar te veel voor deze mooie koffer. Na wat correspondentie heen en weer met Emirates was de conclusie dat ze niks voor mij konden betekenen en de verantwoordelijk niet op zich namen. Mijn conclusie is daarom ook om eens te kijken naar andere maatschappijen waar misschien nog wel service is te verwachten. In ieder geval zal ik Emirates niet meer zo snel boeken. Mijn volgende vlucht naar Bali is gewoon met onze KLM.

author: Kiran Pun
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  It was my first ever travel with Emirates and I have no hesitation to say that it was my first and recent travel will be my last travel with this airline. I have been traveling around for 4 decades. This airline is the worst I have traveled. From boarding desk staffs to aircrews, they are unfriendly, utterly rude and disrespectful. Pathetic all across the board.

author: T Keale
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  Do not fly with Emirates if you don’t like to be squashed by obese passengers.  I pay full price and more for a flex ticket, but I only get 3/4 of a seat as the obese person next to me far is overflowing into my chair.  When I insisted to be moved to another chair it took the staff 15 minutes for the cabin staff to even respond to my calls, they were too busy chatting at the crew area, I was watching them. I had to press the crew call button on and off over 20 times, that’s no exaggeration, before someone came to ask me what I wanted. After pointing out what was going on I was moved to the chair closest to the toilet, almost in the toilet, I could hear everything inside the bathroom. The seat they put me in sticks out into the aisle so every time the air hostess would walk past they would knock my chair, completely lacking awareness or care for the passengers. They really don’t care. it’s difficult to imagine a more incompetent bunch of cabin staff and management controlling an airline. It is 100% the last time I’ll ever consider flying Emirates. I didnt even have have space to even eat my meal so I couldn’t ask for my dinner I couldn’t rest without being leaned on and knocked constantly by the customer overflowing into my chair. This is absolutely unacceptable.
route: Phuket to Cape Town via Dubai

author: E Lorsen
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  Had perishable item, the airline sent is as special luggage and left it behind. As it was a item of importance to me and I was very sad that it was left behind. Very disappointed with Emirates

author: H Mahdam
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  I book my flight from Emirates for my 2 kids me and my wife, paid amount from my card to Emirates. the flight was from Riyadh to Islamabad via Dubai. Departure time from Riyadh was 4:25 PM on 9th of march and arrival time was 7:10 Pm on same date in dubai airport. the 2 hour stay and then departure from Dubai at 9:10 PM same date and arrival 1:30 AM 10th of march. We were handed over to Flydubai from emirates  which was strange bu Ok we did boarding and got notification that flight is delayed.. Total delay in Riyadh was 4 and half hours and reached very late to Dubai airport and the connecting flight were missed. We approach to emirates counter and they rudely refuse to provide us any service because we were having flydubai boarding passes and told us to deal with Flydubai. Long story short we were dealt with like animals for 18 hours in airport and depart to another airport which were around 700 KM away from our  ticketed airport and does not provide any transfortatin from that airport. The car were arranged by us which cost us around 250$. I will never recommend Emirates and flydubai to anyone.

author: J Hasmine
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  The service provided is absolutely unacceptable and beyond what I’ve ever experienced. The flight from Lisbon to Dubai was delayed by 3 hrs. Connecting flight to Phuket was missed due to that which of course can happen but there was zero handling of the situation in Dubai - it took 4,5 hours at the airport standing in lines to get a new boarding pass and a hotel voucher. Before that no information at all. After all this they take you to a hotel which is 30 minutes away from the airport without telling before which hotel and where it is - arriving at the hotel another long waiting session and then no one can say when the shuttle bus is going back to the airport - we don’t have that information, end of conversation! Zero information. Zero service. I booked seats on the flight in advance to be able to rest and in the email about the new flight it said the booked seat will remain for the new flight but that is not the case at all. So now instead of my paid window seat I’m sitting straight in the middle. All the service chat tells you is to file a complaint. Also I paid for a hotel in Phuket that I don’t get to use. This was by far the worst I’ve ever experienced by any airline. It’s such a joke, the way they treat people, their customers. Especially at the airport- no one cared at all for all of the travelers facing this situation. Everyone was treated with pure ignorance. Biggest mistreatment and miss organization ever! Don’t book this airline!

author: P Malden
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  We choose the twin seats at back of plane as this is a long flight and paid for them, well worth the extra on this long flight.The captain kept us updated on turbulence and seatbelt reminder throughout flight. Cabin crew professional and available when needed, plenty of drinks available. Have flown Emirates since 2012 when flying to Europe never had a bad experience, always Economy but been fortunate to be offered upgrade x2. Gluten free meals the best.

author: E Malden
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  Venice to Dubai. My husband & I checked in online 48 hours before departure. Arrived at Venice Marco Polo Airport and took the online check-in line which was very short. The Emirates check-in was very good and answered our questions about our onward flight when arriving in Dubai further connection which was with Qantas to regional airport. We were surprised when given all three boarding passes for continuation to final destination with Qantas Chose aisle seats C/D as far back as possible. Flight was excellent with multilingual crew and co pilot Australian Captain from El Salvador. Always fly to & from to Europe with Emirates well looked after and the best gluten free meals. Arrived on time.

author: E Galetski
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  Our BKK-DXB flight was delayed for 18 hours and as a result we missed our DXB WAW connecting flight. We were offered a long flight with one more transfer DXX-LJU - WAW no longer on Emirates and FlyDubai on budget airlines where the standard was far below expectations. Unfortunately, because of Emirates we also missed the next transfer and instead of 16 hours our journey lasted over 60 hours. The worst thing is that the Emirates hotline showed no interest in our problems. We personally had to nervously look for connections to WAW. I filed a complaint, but Emirates did not respond. They awarded bonus miles instead, but I never want to use Emirates again. It is certainly not a premium airline which shows absolutely no interest to problems of their passengers and to their misconduct. I feel robbed. If I had been focused on low price, not taking service / comfort / time of journey, I would have chosen some different airline paying less. Yet, I paid much, much more and I got absolutely long journey, poor service, absolute disrespect from Emirates hotline, and no refund. They gave me worthless bonus miles. Never again am I going to fly with Emirates - budget airlines seem to be a better option with lower prices

author: E Bayaz
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  Definitely not the standard I would expect from a premium airline. Business class seats and layout are dated and service levels at gates and checking in are well below other competitors. The economy class is well below Qatar Airways too. Counter staff are unhelpful especially at the UK counters. I would have been better off trying Saudia instead. This is definitely not the experience of Emirates that I have had over 10 years ago. Qatar Airways really puts them to shame.
route: London Stansted to Lahore via Dubai

author: E Lasene
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  My husband and I bought tickets to do Paris Seychelles transit Dubai. On arrival in Seychelles my suitcase was not delivered to us. We wait 25 minutes. And at the end of that time, a plastic bag arrives closed with a ribbon into which a quarter of my remaining belongings are thrown. Everything else was stolen. The suitcase was therefore opened despite an empty padlock and the rest of my belongings stashed in a plastic bag. I immediately opened a dispute, sending 37 emails since January 6. I called every two days, no one answered me. I only received automatic emails, with zero follow-up concerning me. I therefore lost more than €6,000 in business, not including the round trip to Paris Seychelles. Unacceptable treatment of customers. Nous avons acheté Mon Mari et moi des billets pour faire Paris Seychelles transit Dubaï. À l’arrivée aux Seychelles ma valise ne nous est pas livré. Nous attendons 25 minutes. Et au bout de ce temps-là, arrive un sac plastique fermé par un ruban dans lequel sont jetés un quart de mes affaires Qui restait. Tout le reste a été volé. La valise a donc été ouverte malgré un cadenas vidé et le reste de mes affaires planqué dans un sac en plastique. J’ai immédiatement ouvert un litige, envoyer 37 mails depuis le 6 janvier. J’ai appelé tous les deux jours, personne ne m’a répondu. Je n’ai que reçu des mails automatiques, Avec zéro suivi me concernant. J’ai perdu donc plus de 6000 € d’affaires, sans compter l’aller-retour, Paris Seychelles. Inadmissible le traitement des clients.

author: E Davies
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | Every step of the travel, I found harassment, terrible customer support, and absolutely no help. I am treated like an economy class customer in all aspects. Check-in: 1. Rude arrogant check in staff at SFO: refused to accommodate a box that exceeded 59 inches though far underweight than half of 70 kgs allowed. Arrogant staff refused to ever entertain my request as the app clearly mentioned that I could take up to 115 inches, without mentioning additional cost over 59 inches. 2. Reached DXB. At the gate, someone came over with my name and he was not aware of hotel option despite mentioning that I received it in my last trip. When I finally approach Terminal 3 First class lounge, they gave me hotel voucher after a lot of time. Even lounge front desk didn't have that information. 3. The lounge front desk refused to help me get to chauffeur service, didn't tell me 'EXACT' steps on how to reach Arrivals. It was the most terrible experience for someone going there for the first time. The desk that manages Chauffer service was incompetent and provided inaccurate gate info where I could get car to hotel. All this exercise took 1.5 hours, eating up on my plans to go out to the city. 4. When I checked back in the following day, 27th Feb, the second bag was not loaded despite being first class, despite paying for it and despite 19 hours of transit. When I landed and waited for it at carousel, app displayed delayed bag with PIR info. 5. Apparently the customer service agents pretended that they cannot get my contact details to update the baggage claim report/PIR and kept blaming me for it. They knew the flight I was in, the bag number and access to my profile, but kept saying that they can't update me because I didn't provide phone number and email address, both were there in my Emirates profile long before my travel date. 6. No communication on missed bag despite repeated contacts with customer support. Emirates has provided the worst travel experience all around in spite of paying for first class and for additional baggage. This is my last trip with Emirates and request everyone to not waste their money/miles on Emirates. You will always hit a wall in getting somethin we think is customer service. There will be no help, no customer support, no sensitivity or understanding. All I experienced is arrogant highhandedness, no respect for customers.
route: San Francisco to Hyderabad via Dubai

author: Ali Norri
review_text: Not Verified | Do not fly with Emirates and FlyDubai. Extremely poor management from Emirates and Dubai Airport. Did not have permission to leave Baghdad and had to wait for 4 hours and arrived late to connection flight to Sydney. Once arrived to Dubai, provided new flight in 9 hours with no accommodation and no other services. This is an example of extreme mismanagement of Dubai Airport and Emirates. And when you ask their staff for help, they literary try to ignore you.

author: P Malden
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  Booked flight on Emirates website but first part of journey was from regional Australia with Qantas flight. Luggage checked all way through to Dubai so did not have to transfer it at Brisbane. Checked in on line and when arrived in Brisbane the customer service was very good allowing us to change seats to back of plane as was not a full flight so had 3 seats for 2 passengers, a very comfortable flight and the cabin crew bringing around drinks between meal service. Arrived Safely in Dubai on time.

author: Massimo Reverberi
review_text: Not Verified |  A real disappointment. Emirates costs 25% more than Etihad or Qatar for the same route, but the service was bad. First flight was 2,5 hours late. The seat I selected was reassigned by the system and no explanations were given at the counter. Return flight was 1 hour late. Online check in system was down for two days and I could not select a seat (getting a terrible one location at the check-in counter). Guess this is my last time with Emirates, since there are cheaper and better performing options on the same route.

author: J Smith
