Lufthansa’s failure to deliver on their promise or provide timely updates has turned our trip into a frustrating experience. I urge other travelers to be cautious when flying with Lufthansa and to share similar experiences to hold the airline accountable. I’m still waiting for a resolution and expect better from a premium carrier.

author: Daria Mamchankova
review_text: Not Verified | I was flying from Barcelona to Gdańsk with a connecting flight in Munich. Because the first flight was delayed, it was physically impossible to make the connection. The airline offered an alternative flight departing a few hours later. Since I ultimately arrived in Gdańsk 4 hours later than scheduled, I was entitled to compensation. When I wrote to the airline about this, they agreed and asked for all the necessary bank details in order to send me this compensation. The amount was supposed to arrive within 10 days, but more than a month has already passed and the money has not arrived. I wrote to them about it via email, but they do not respond. Every one of my emails is ignored. I have written to various email addresses of theirs, no one answers, and this issue is not being resolved in any way. I am very upset by the company's attitude.

author: Derek Northcutt
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Paid for upgrade to business class ($712,54) and was promised three things: An “elevated” dining experience; A comfortable lie-flat bed; Access to the Business Class Lounges. The catering onboard was without question below average, offered only one choice of starter (meat and cream cheese), three choices for meal, and one choice for dessert (fruit plate and cheese are not dessert items). I ordered the Shrimp and Scallop stir-fry, which turned out to be about the same quality and taste profile as a reheatable meal. The dessert I choice, bread pudding, was not a bread pudding but a cold square of an apple cake. The lie-flat bed was extremely uncomfortable – narrow, not flat, and inadequately cushioned. I was refused entry to the business class lounge at Los Angeles, Chicago O’Hare, & Flughafen Frankfurt-Rhein-Main for specious reasons I do not recall. I was publicly embarrassed three times when making the request for entry.The ground services at O'Hare was just chaotic and unprofessional. This agent barring passengers from this seating area, boarding passengers in three different areas, and, of course, American-style customer service (meaning no one knows how to talk to the public). I will mention here that staff were as always very kind and gracious. Just another "basic airline" that wants the revenue from premium passengers without providing the service.

author: L Olsen
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | We can understand that the cancelation which is because of Typhoon. 500+ flights canceled and we needed to wait on 3-days for return flight which was understandable. However, to ask for an official letter for the flight cancelation in terms of we can claim our travel insurance. It's a ping pong play between Swiss, Lufthansa and Cathay Pacific. It's been two weeks now and they are still pointing fingers to each other. The whole thing with emails all time. Just asked for an official letter with date, time and reason of cancelation. We went through times Customer hotlines with Lufthansa, Customer hotlines with Cathy Pacific. Multiple emails with all three airlines and still nothing. If the airlines can't make it right, please don't provide such option.
route: Hong Kong to Luxembourg via Frankfurt

author: E Lanic
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   I was denied boarding on flight LH1710 from Munich to Dubrovnik on August 2nd due to overbooking. While I understand that overbooking can happen, the way it was handled was unacceptable. The ground staff at the gate showed no empathy or effort to explain the situation. Passengers who arrived later at the gate than I did were allowed to board, and I was placed on standby without any clear explanation or fair prioritization. Only after I insisted was I given a confirmation that the denial of boarding was due to overbooking. I received compensation, but not a full explanation or the full rights I was entitled to under EU Regulation 261/2004.

author: M Tabakovic
review_text: Not Verified | We taxied to the runway, only for the plane to abruptly slow down and return. We remained seated on the plane for over 3 hours, during which we received conflicting and increasingly concerning updates. After one hour We need to refuel since we were on the ground too long. After another hour: We are having engine problems.  After yet another hour: We will switch you to a different aircraft.  Finally, it was announced the flight would be delayed until the next day, and that we would be taken to a hotel for the night. We had two small children with us, and being confined on the plane for three hours with no food, no clear updates, and no solution was both exhausting and distressing. The situation worsened once we deplaned. I told the service desk representative that I could not continue walking long distances, as we had already been up and down stairs multiple times. They said they would arrange for a cart to transport us through the airport—but we were left waiting for an hour. When the cart finally arrived, I was told no children were allowed, so we were forced to walk across the airport. The real reason for the delay was only revealed the next day: Customs in St. Louis was closed. Why was this not communicated from the start?

author: Eleonora Simeonova
review_text: Not Verified |   We recently had a terrible experience at Toronto Pearson Airport while traveling with our four-year-old daughter. We arrived at the airport 1.5 hours before our international flight to Sofia (via Germany). We asked the Lufthansa service desk if there was a fast lane or any priority process for families with young children as there was only 1.5 hours left before our flight departed. We were told no and directed to a long line marked “Bag Drop Only.” After waiting over 30 minutes in line, we reached the counter with 1 hour left before takeoff, only to be told it was "too late" to check our bags. The staff offered no assistance other than telling us we could throw away our checked luggage and run to the gate with only carry-ons. The supervisor showed zero empathy, refused to listen, and ultimately blocked us from flying. We pleaded for understanding and assistance, but were met with cold, rigid responses and no effort to help. There was no fast lane, no signage warning of cut-off times, and no ownership from Lufthansa for their poor process at the airport.  We had to pay out of pocket to rebook everything. For a premium airline, Lufthansa’s customer service was anything but professional.

author: Felix Rowan
review_text: Not Verified |  The flight was fine and the flight crew are friendly and nice to passengers. However Lufthansa's customer service is the most awful I have encountered. I was bumped off of my outbound flight (with the wording of the Lufthansa app implying that the flights were cancelled outright) from LHR to BER with a stopover in BRU onto a flight I could not make, and Lufthansa has been incredibly incompetent and unhelpful in sorting it out, nearly always redirecting me to Brussels Airlines, who operated the flight, who then redirect me back to Lufthansa because it was a Lufthansa booking. Lufthansa's customer service don't seem to understand that the two airlines operate within the same group, nor do they at all give the impression that they care about helping you. I wrote this review to make sure that Lufthansa does not get away with the fact that they are clearly completely negligent about their help service. You're fine if you don't have any issues on your flight, but if you do, god help you, because Lufthansa certainly won't. If you find yourself in this situation, ask for Nate at the Lufthansa help center. They have been the only helpful Lufthansa employee in this matter.

author: Samuel Freeman
review_text: ✅ TripVerified |   The flight to Frankfurt goes smoothly, but we almost miss our connecting aircraft because we arrived at gate A1, and our next plane was at Z99. As if almost missing the connection was bad enough, the plane diverted to Salt Lake City due to a storm in Denver, turning the 10h flight into a 15h flight. After all that, and a good half hour of waiting at the customs baggage carousel, we learn that our checked bags did not make the connection with us. Our bags finally arrived at our house, over 36h late, but that means next to nothing now. I had to delete my miles & more account because of this.

author: P Hortiere
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |  Washington Dulles to Munich on Lufthansa A380 – Business class award ticket obtained from UA Mileage Plus program. The Lufthansa lounge in Washington Dulles is very disappointing, with a poor choice of rather low quality foods. This was a late flight (10:20 pm) and our goal was to have dinner in the lounge to go to sleep after takeoff. The food offering was what you can expect from a school cafeteria in a country with limited financial resources. The only positive points were the flight attendants, who were pleasant and attentitve, and the pre-departure nuts and chocolate candy, which were of good quality. The lie-flat seat was atrocious and breakfast was forgettable. The very dated side-by-side arrangement did not bother us but the seat itself was narrow and encumbered with protruding metal parts which made falling asleep quasi-impossible. Result, an exhausting 8-hour flight and a totally unacceptable experience overall for a business class transatlantic trip. The flight left and arrrived essentially on-time.

author: T Haseiger
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   My penultimate flight with Lufthansa in First Class was impressive in every respect – not only because of the high level of comfort, but above all because of the exceptionally dedicated staff. Even the stay in the First Class terminal in Frankfurt was a very pleasant start. The service was unobtrusive, efficient, and personal – everything ran smoothly, from check-in to the direct ride to the aircraft with the limousine service. This impression continued on board. I would particularly like to highlight the purser, who introduced herself personally, was present throughout the entire flight, and kept an overview at all times without appearing distant. She had a few personal words for each guest – professional yet warm. The welcome from the captain (before takeoff, of course), who personally took the time to introduce himself, was a strong signal of the appreciation he felt for the First Class guests. This kind of closeness to the crew is something you rarely experience – and it made a noticeable difference. The cabin crew was outstanding: attentive, courteous, and always one step ahead without being intrusive. It was noticeable that this was a well-coordinated team that truly enjoyed their work. The seat—or rather, the little private sanctuary—offered everything you could wish for on a long-haul flight: plenty of space, high-quality materials, pleasant peace and quiet, and a very comfortable bed. Even after many hours, I felt fresh and relaxed. The catering was consistently of a high standard. The caviar service was classic and very well presented, the dishes were delicious and beautifully presented. The selection of drinks—especially the wines and champagne—was also high-quality and well-curated. In conclusion, Lufthansa First Class impresses not only with its exceptional comfort and quality, but above all with people who take their work seriously and do it with passion. It was a journey where every detail was perfect—calm, well-thought-out, and to the point.  Mein vorletzter Flug mit Lufthansa in der First Class war in jeder Hinsicht beeindruckend – nicht nur wegen des hohen Komforts, sondern vor allem durch das außergewöhnlich engagierte Personal. Bereits der Aufenthalt im First Class Terminal in Frankfurt war ein höchst angenehmer Einstieg. Der Service war unaufdringlich, effizient und persönlich – alles lief reibungslos, vom Check-in bis zur direkten Fahrt zum Flugzeug mit dem Limousinen-Service. An Bord setzte sich dieser Eindruck fort. Besonders hervorheben möchte ich die Purserin, die sich persönlich vorstellte, den gesamten Flug über präsent war und jederzeit den Überblick behielt, ohne dabei distanziert zu wirken. Sie hatte für jeden Gast ein paar persönliche Worte übrig – professionell und gleichzeitig herzlich. Auch die Begrüßung durch den Kapitän (natürlich noch vor dem Start), der sich persönlich Zeit nahm, um sich vorzustellen, war ein starkes Signal für die Wertschätzung gegenüber den First-Class-Gästen. Diese Art von Nähe zur Crew erlebt man selten – und sie machte einen spürbaren Unterschied. Das Kabinenpersonal war hervorragend: aufmerksam, zuvorkommend und immer einen Schritt voraus, ohne aufdringlich zu wirken. Es war spürbar, dass hier ein eingespieltes Team mit echter Freude an der Arbeit unterwegs war. Der Sitz – oder besser gesagt, das kleine private Refugium – bot alles, was man sich auf einem Langstreckenflug wünschen kann: viel Platz, hochwertige Materialien, angenehme Ruhe und ein sehr bequemes Bett. Auch nach vielen Stunden fühlte ich mich frisch und entspannt. Das Catering war durchweg auf hohem Niveau. Der Kaviarservice war klassisch und sehr gut präsentiert, die Speisen geschmacklich überzeugend und schön angerichtet. Auch die Auswahl an Getränken – insbesondere die Weine und der Champagner – war hochwertig und gut kuratiert. Fazit: Lufthansa First Class überzeugt nicht nur durch ausgesprochenen Komfort und Qualität, sondern vor allem durch Menschen, die ihre Arbeit ernst nehmen und mit Leidenschaft ausführen. Es war eine Reise, bei der jedes Detail stimmte – unaufgeregt, durchdacht und auf den Punkt.

author: C Hales
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   I fly this route on LH three times a year. Each time, the boarding process at Frankfurt gets worse. Chaos, confusion, not boarding by groups, it looked like they opened the gates a a football stadium and there was pushing, shoving and no consideration for small children or people with mobility issues. Why can't they get it right? It's so easy. On board, the staff is very courteous even in the face of catering issues. Several of the items offered on the menu for dinner were not boarded. A chicken piccata appeared as a slice of chicken covered in green sauce. Breakfast was a write-off. Coffee warm/tepid. I fly LH because it gets me to my destination on time. Not because of the inflight entertainment on outdated screens of the tired cabins. LH needs to improve to compete with the other European airlines flying to EZE. Great checkin staff at EZE - to be commended.

author: Christian Klein
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Okay flight, as usual very expensive for minimal service, only water is included in 3hr flight. Terrible ground crew in Frankfurt, and delays create a terrible value for money

author: H Johnson
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | Excellent service but terrible seats. Flew DC to Frankfurt. Great food and wonderful, attentive service but the lie flat seats were very uncomfortable, hard, and not conducive to sleep. In flight entertainment desperately needs updating.

author: James Williamson
review_text: Not Verified | Both flights were on time and were both very full. However the seats were comfortable for the fairly short flights. Were given a bottle of water and a small branded Lindt Chocolate on both flights. Cabin crew were friendly and efficient. Would fly again.

author: Colette Hollins
review_text: Not Verified |  I did not get the opportunity to agree to the new flight schedule but Lufthansa went ahead and confirmed the changes and issued boarding passes. I’m perplexed to who in their right mind would think it reasonable to schedule a 24 hour transit time. At check-in I managed to negotiate a route to bring the delay down to 12 hours with transit times in two airports of 5 and 6 hours respectively. Find at destination baggage has not arrived.

author: Andreas Becker
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | Both flights on time. Lounge in HAJ was ok for small airport. On the 30 mins flight to FRA they manage to serve a small dish, carrot tartare. Looks and taste perfect. The new lounge in FRA near the Z gates is a clear improvement. Cabin in A 340 still like ten years ago. 2-2-2 configuration. Seats are comfortable. IFE technic outdated. Crew was very attentive. Food was tasty and good choice. Overall the Business Class in the A 340 is average as outdated. Nevertheless seats are comfortable. But compared to many asian or mideast airlines too expensive for the value.
route: Hannover to Hong Kong via Frankfurt

author: U Hybel
review_text: Not Verified | The only possibility to get to Munich from Barcelona (24th of March till 27th of March) was Lufthansa. First time with them and it will be the last time.  I arrived at 14:35 at Munich and bagage drop off was (according boarding pass) possible till 14:45. Unfortunately the lady at the counter said, this is only for business class. At the service counter they offered me a flight through Zurich to Barcelona. Total costs EURO 250. After my flight tried to claim the money. The only reaction was, sorry for you and this will help us to avoid those situations. No offer or refund.

author: Jennifer Lobo
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |    I purchased business class seats from NYC to Frankfurt to Malta. Total expected flight time was 12 hours, 22 minutes. Due to a 3.5 hour delay out of JFK, I missed my connecting flight from Frankfurt. I was re-routed to Rome to catch a flight to Malta. I waited at the airport in Frankfurt 3 1/2 hours and boarded the flight to Rome. The flight to Rome was delayed so I missed my re-routed 9 PM flight to Malta. Passengers on the Rome flight destined for Malta were told by the airline, before we landed, to meet a van on the tarmac to be re-routed to Malta. Upon arriving at the office I was told there were no more flights to Malta that evening. I was already 7 hours delayed from my original itinerary and was now facing another 10 hour delay and an overnight stay in Rome. While I was waiting in line to be given a flight departing the next day, I discovered another flight destined for Malta departing Rome at 11 PM. I dashed to the gate and purchased another ticket on this Ryan Air midnight flight. Hence I purchased two tickets for airfare to Malta (Frankfurt / Malta and Rome/ Malta). I arrived in Malta at 12:40 am so I spent a total of 22 hours reaching my destination. I was certain that Lufthansa would reimburse me for the very expensive flight I purchased from Frankfurt to Malta. Instead they responded that I could not be reimbursed because I used the ticket from Rome to Malta, which of course I could not use since our flight to Rome arrived 3 minutes before the Malta flight departed Rome from many gates away. Then I was told that I did not qualify for EU 261 compensation even though I arrived at my final destination almost 10 hours later than my scheduled itinerary and was eating my dinner at 1:20 am a day after my scheduled arrival. Then after seven months of letters and emails, Lufthansa finally agreed a 10 hour delay qualified for EU 261 compensation so they sent me my compensation but they still argued I had used their ticket from Rome to Malta so I could not be reimbursed for my unused business class ticket.. Since then, I produced evidence showing I purchased my own new ticket from Rome  to Malta at 10:23 pm on American Express in Rome, well after the Rome to Malta flight departed so I could not have been on the flight to Malta that departed Rome at 9:00 pm. In light of this "revelation", eight months after my trip, they are re-studying my case to see if I should be reimbursed for the unused Frankfurt to Malta ticket. A few days ago they informed me they forwarded my case to Swiss Air, because they sold me the ticket.
route: New York to Malta via Frankfurt

author: E Huang
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Positive: flight departed on time. Boarding was organized. Staff was very courteous. They exceeded expectation. They handed out activity kit for my toddler and I loved that. My kid absolutely loved Lu & Cosmo, the Lufthansa kids birds (cranes?) He was devastated to find out we weren't flying Lufthansa on our route back. Food was ok, not amazing, not terrible. Actually, I wrote this review after experiencing an American Airlines meal, so Lufthansa gets a grade bump. Wi-fi is not free. I had to pay to arrange for seats. IMO if young children are included in a booking, there should be an option to seat everyone together regardless of where - I don't need front row seats, I just need to make sure I'm the one handling my toddler. Their in flight entertainment screen is really janky. The touchscreen sometimes worked sometimes didn't. They weighed our carry on before boarding. Thankfully I already heard they can be strict about this, so we made sure our carry on was quite a few oz under at home. But people got charged and they had to get their carry on checked if it was over weight.

author: J Horten
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   I purchased a business class seat well in advance, and when I arrived at the airport to check in, I was told that I was downgraded because the flight was overbooked. I told them to get me on another airline in the same class to get me to my final destination on time and reimburse me for the hotel I had booked during my extended layover. The only options they gave me were to either fly in a lower class or fly the next day. I told her I wanted to speak with a Lufthansa manager, who came out, and said that under EC 261/2004/EC, I am eligible to get refunded 75% of my flight price. Since I could not fly the next day, I was forced to fly in a lower class than what I paid for.  When I got to my final destination, there was no customer service phone number to handle refunds, so I had to submit it online. After multiple weeks, Luthansa deflected to take responsibility, and after multiple e-mail exchanges over months, they finally said they are closing my case because I flew in the same class that I purchased. I had to actively fight and provide proof of my boarding pass in a lower class and my receipt showing that I purchased a business class seat. It has now been over 4 months, and I still have not received any satisfactory resolution.

author: E Gordon
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | At the outset, I must say the crew were great as always. However the penny pinching is really noticeable, served Ribera prior to take off, cheap disposable headsets that were so bad I couldn't hear well enough to watch anything, and the quality of the screen is from a previous era. Basic wifi messaging access is chargeable on LH, yet something I've not paid for on other airlines on recent trips.

author: Ashima Raheja
review_text: Not Verified |  On 6th May, I took LH631 and the first thing I experienced was unavailability of the WiFi in air.  And then the luggage went missing at Frankfurt airport. There was no information or news about the luggage from the airline. Passengers were stranded near the luggage belt for more than 1.5 hours wondering what happened. The beauty of the horrendous Frankfurt airport is that one has to step out of the luggage belt area to inquire about luggage. When all passengers finally decided to walk from gate A to Gate B to report this, the lady at the counter said “oh the staff just found a container that they forgot after offloading from the plane”.  LH took zero accountability or responsibility to inform or apologize to passengers.

author: Michael Binas
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   My first time flying on Lufhansa and I must say I was impressed overall. Ground service was OK while on board was excellent. Crew were great while food was sufficient enough for the six-hour flight. The only drawback for me was the bus boarding on FRA-RUH. Other than that everything was above the mark.

author: Floyd Chorley
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   In September 2024 I had a metal box taking up my leg room on an 11 hour flight which was attached to the underneath of the seat. I raised it with the cabin crew and was told I couldn't move. I raised a complaint with Lufthansa afterwards, and received stock template responses from people who clearly didn't ready or understand the issue whatsoever. They ignored my requests for the complaint to be escalated to a manger and then closed the case and stopped responding.

author: N Bardel
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Long flight in their outdated business class. Seated in the upper deck, which always is a nice experience. Soft product just ok (not overwhelming) and luckily I had a nice flight attendant, which made the whole experience acceptable. Purser was rather more interested to engage with Brazilian guests, maybe to show others he spoke Portuguese.

author: N Bardel
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Rarely have seen such an uninspiring and not interested crew. The the buy on board service didn’t have any of the sandwiches on board.  No apologies, no willingness to try to accommodate, no eye-contact (not to mention a smile). Even with the obliging much paying customers to buy on board anything more than a mini mini bottle of water and a ridiculous small chocolate, clearly also in this domain Lufthansa is here amateur! Now, besides the fact I really fly a lot (50+ flights/yr with LH-Group) with this airline, sometime I wonder why I am doing this to me.

author: Michael Thomas
review_text: Not Verified |  During my arrival and transfer in Frankfurt. We were made to board a plane via bus on the tarmac and deboard due to cancellation. This was after a 4 hour delay. I was then re routed to Brussels making me a day late for Passover in Israel. Very poor customer service. Only chat bot available to handle issues.

author: Tammy Mackenzie
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | I have significant international travel experience having been to over 40 countries. During the last 2+ years we fly only business class because of a medical service animal that is an Australian Shepard that has to be with my daughter. Since flying with her (the medical service animal) we have used British Airways, United, Air France (received a commendation certificate), KLM, Air Canada/West Jet, Porter and Ryanair. I always provide all the documents: medical service dog, Dr. requirement, Canadian Certification, Trainers letter, Export Document (CFIA certified), vaccine and blood work record (CFIA certified), health certificate and of course breed/weight and no incontinence for long periods of travel some up to 20 hours. I had not flown Lufthansa in roughly a decade and decided to give them a try since historically they had been great. What a shock! Their response was very slow taking over a week and then denied her requesting documents that were already provided to medical service. I resent the documents only to be left at pending. I called the Vancouver International Airport the day before our April 13th flight and was told she was confirmed. We arrive at the airport only to find out her status had not changed and being a Sunday no one was available in medical service to assist. We waited nearly 2 hours while Lufthansa workers tried desperately to help us without luck. Finally, a manager came down and said Lufthansa listed no documents received. At this point we are in panic mode but through her review of the documents asked me to email them directly to her. Upon receipt she removed the pending and we were able to board our flight to Croatia. This could have been catastrophic for both service animal and my daughter. I want to thank all those in Vancouver to assisted us and all on board attendance for their kindness and professionalism. I no longer can recommend this airline not only for their disregard for passenger health but also the quality of the pods, I have always only experience great sleep in business class and these were obviously very dated and once reclined I need attendant manual assistance to resume to the up right position several times. The over 9 hour flight had below average quality of food but non of this is reflective of the staff we actually met and spoke with but are all airline issues.
route: Vancouver BC to Split Croatia via Odessa

author: E Layne
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   What a disappointing experience. Our outbound flight was on SwissAir and the quality of the cabin and service was equal to Singapore Airlines which was code-shared. We were expecting something similar on our homebound flight with Lufthansa but as soon as we boarded it became obvious that this wasn't to be the case. The plane was old, I haven't seen one like it for at least ten years. We were in the upstairs cabin but there was no privacy between the seats and there was, bizarrely, a service station halfway down the cabin, so the stewardesses were plating food and scraping leftovers directly in front of our seats. The screens were small and not touch-screen so you had to use a wired hand-held device to move a cursor on the screen. I gave up trying to scroll through the options as it was so unresponsive. The food was uninspired. The flight staff were pleasant but not particularly friendly and we didn't see them at all between dinner and breakfast. They didn't help to set up our beds which were so narrow that you couldn't turn over and the bedding was thin and not very comfy. There was only one bathroom for 18 seats and the waste bin hadn't been emptied overnight so in the morning there was no space for towels etc. Suffice to say that we will not be flying Lufthansa business class again.

author: R Morton
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   I recently (March 2025) was on a business trip from US to Europe. The original flight was cancelled due to a strike in Frankfurt. I fly a lot, so not the first time. But this is when several red flags began to happen. The first red flag was Lufthansa did not offer an alternative flight. The only way to communicate with them was through a chat bot, there was no real person to talk to. The only options I had was to refund my flight and completely new book, which would have been insanely expensive or to update to another flight two days later for an additional $650. Why Lufthansa did not offer this update for free was beyond me to understand. Lufthansa refused to reimburse me these $650. I ended up paying more than $2,500 for a flight ticket from the East Coast of US to Frankfurt.  But it gets better. The first flight was a leg from Raleigh to Newark. That flight was delayed, which then led to me being rebooked on a Lufthansa flight from Newark to Munich, which also was delayed, which then led again for me to be rebooked on a different flight from Munich to Frankfurt. The funny part is that a United customer service agent was able to rebook me last minute on a flight to Germany on Lufthansa. Something that Lufthansa was not able to do two days earlier when their flight was cancelled! This last-minute rebooking of course also led to a downgrade of my booked class. I flew Economy.  Over this entire process, Lufthansa has lost my luggage. At that point, I only had two days in Europe anyways, but all the appointments that I cramped into those two days had to be cancelled, because I literally only had one change of cloth with me. Thankfully my mother lives in Germany, so I could rent a car and drive to my mother to stay until my luggage was found. At that point, I already has another flight to Asia, so I lost an entire week of work, thanks to Lufthansa. At the end of the day, I paid more than $2,500 for an economy class flight from Raleigh to Frankfurt, that was more than 48 hours too late, and during which my luggage was lost. Lufthansa has not given me a cent of reimbursement. Dealing with their customer service, which you only can reach via web portal, is an absolute pain. They expect you to know all the Lufthansa specific rules and regulations. It seems their main aim is not to satisfy their customer, but to save as much money as possible. I travel a lot for work, and I flew many many airlines in my life. I always looked forward to fly Lufthansa. But this experience has changed my mind. There are many other airlines that fly to Europe. They all have to deal with strikes, they all lose luggage sometimes. But every single airline I ever flew with, even the US based airlines, were friendlier and more helpful in their customer relations than Lufthansa. Lufthansa just lost a customer in me. And I don't wish for anyone to have the same experience.

author: Christopher Yang
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | Even though it was a short early morning flight, I still had a good experience with Lufthansa. I still get the same amenities, like bottled water and a Lindt Milk Chocolate bar with the Lufthansa logo. Other than that, there is nothing incredibly major to explain regarding issues.

author: Christopher Yang
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | It's been seven years since I last flew on Lufthansa. I was fortunate enough to fly on Lufthansa for the first time in seven years, and the moment I got on that plane, I felt good. Because it was a short flight, I didn't have to worry about anything. But the best part was that I got a Milk Chocolate bar from Lindt, and what's nice is that they have a Lufthansa logo on it - what a finishing touch.

author: S Mayle
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Not only did Lufthansa cancel our flight two days in a row, we had to deal with an incredible amount of chaos and confusion. At one point, TSA had to send us back to the Lufthansa counter because we were given boarding passes for the wrong day. It was the same chaos on every leg of our flights. In Naples, the gate attendant was rude and made no effort to have the plane board in an orderly fashion. Lufthansa promised to pay for at least a portion of the cost of the hotel room I booked when our first flight was cancelled. It has been almost three months since they promised to compensate me and I have received nothing. When I contacted them to ask about it, it took nearly a month for them to send me a form letter saying, "We're looking into it." I have heard nothing since and I have no hope of ever receiving the promised compensation.

author: S Lavic
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   On February 20th we travel from Zagreb to Dubai via Frankfurt, service, food, movie options etc was horrible. They cancelled our flights on March 1st and they just rebooked us on March 2nd without our permission. I decided to call their customer service by phone to find alternative flight on March 1st but they told me that they don't have alternative flights on March 1st. I tried to change my final destination to Venice or Ljubljana just to fly on same day as per our original schedule, but customer service said there was no any alternative options. So my family had been rebooked for the next day but without any accommodation. They told me that they will reimburse me for hotel. I have not request reimbursement yet but i will post new review if all will go smooth or i will need to spend days and days to solve my problems.

author: N Bardel
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   A poor low cost experience with full service airline Lufthansa, for which I paid a high fare. Got a cup of water and a chocolate (10 gr). Kindly enough they let me have a second chocolate (because I nicely asked). In their Tourist Class (not that their intra-European Business Class is anything great much better), Lufthansa (& Co.) are nothing better than any other low cost airline when flying in Europe. The only difference is that most of the European low cost airlines are consistent, you get what you pay for and there are no surprises. Not with Lufthansa: pay higher fares, add luggage, seats etc and get the full no-service experience!

author: R Hardele
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Tokyo to Munich, more than 14h airborne. Legroom on A350 of Lufthansa is comparable to Ryanair. Pure and simple. However they thought a steep reclining angle of the seats would make it better. All you will get is your IFE screen 5cm from your head with no ability to grab anything from the bag under the seat in front. Lufthansa should be ashamed of themselves. Wi-Fi never worked, you couldn’t even connect and trigger the captive login page. They did not try to fix it and didn’t seem to care much as “it is not free anyway”. Well text messaging is free and that’s what 90% of people want. Generally the crew was unpleasant, dismissive, and looked like they would rather be anywhere other than here.  IFE was non responsive at first, had to be rebooted, and was still the slowest IFE I experienced but at least it works. However selection of content was decent with a lot of choice. 5 Had a look at the premium economy section when booking, and considered upgrading. However, when on the plane, it looks just as miserable as our section. There is not even a clear separation between the two, and you’re better off trying to get an extra legroom seat in economy. On the return of the same trip, almost missed my correspondence for the same reason.

author: Chris Jones
review_text: Not Verified |  According to their service desk, Lufthansa did not transfer my bags to Frankfurt, and therefore, I was going to be without clothes and essentials for 3 days. I verified with them that I could buy clothing because I had business meetings and would be reimbursed. Upon returning home and submitting receipts for reasonable clothing, although it was not comparable to my own, they delayed. I received an email from their customer relations that they would not cover the full amount, which was only approximately $700 USD. Instead, they only authorized $460 USD. I will make every effort moving forward to avoid having to fly with Lufthansa as they apparently do not keep their word on reimbursement and you will be stuck paying out of pocket for their mistakes.

author: M Budny
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | My experience during this Christmas Eve flight was horrible. Of course comfort of seats is very good. But service was very poor. Flight has started about 22:30. So it was very late for dinner. I think everybody agree that we pay for excellent food and service quality during long-haul flight in business class. This is even more important during Christmas eve. First of all, chaos was visible among the crew from the very beginning. We were given drinks and snacks. However, then the drinks trolley was parked in the middle of the cabin and nothing happened for the next hour. During this hour, one stewardess was constantly engaged in conversation with passengers in the first row. Then the left side of the cabin began to be served by another group of crew, who were very slowly taking orders. Our right side remained unattended for another hour. When the left side of the cabin was finishing its meal, people came to serve the right side of the cabin. However, it turned out that there was practically nothing to choose from. The only options left were some vegetarian dishes, mainly based on red beetroot. Let me remind you that it was Christmas Eve. The stewardess, of course, was only expressing her regret. After another long waiting time, it turned out that other dishes from the menu were found and we finally we got what we asked for. Dinner ended at 2:30 a.m. Unfortunately, irritation and hunger did not allow for a pleasant time during the flight. I do not recommend business class in Lufthansa. This is very poor quality.

author: F Bemirchu
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Business class flights from LAX to Delhi via Frankfurt. The flight was delayed in Los Angeles, and we missed our connection in Frankfurt. There were about 15 passengers who presented to the boarding gate at Frankfurt. The agents did not care to help, and we were left to figure things out. The return flight from Mumbai was delayed and we missed our connection to Frankfurt from Munich. The flight attendants in Mumbai to Munich flight were unprofessional. Food was served on tables without mats, no syrup for pancakes, etc. When I complained to the purser, we were rewarded without worthless, useless phone coupons. It was a terrible experience. I would not do this again or recommend Lufthansa to anyone.
route: Los Angeles to Delhi / Frankfurt & Munich

author: Suhail Kazim
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   My expectations were very high and I was disappointed because the entire experience was much more business class rather than first class. The first-class terminal was fine but no comparison to the first-class lounges of Emirates or Qatar Airways. Being taken to the plane in a vehicle was a nice experience. The plane was an old 747-8 and it was a nice experience to be in the nose of the plane. Strange enough business class p[passengers had the option of preselecting meals whereas first class did not. The service was typical German type- efficient but not warm. The best part of the flight was the comfortable flat bed which made me sleep for many hours very comfortably. The TV screen was terrible and IFE not impressive at all. Wifi was free for first class but speed was average.

author: John Heslop
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Flew with them about 15 years ago and vowed never again. I thought that they may have improved. Alas, no. By the time that cabin crew got to row 30 (with another 96 passengers left to go back to row 41), they had run out of choice of food and there was only vegetarian left. I advised that I did not want vegetarian and also advised that I tried to book my meal online between three days and four hours before departure (on four different occasions) and was informed that the service was unavailable. I had the beef in sauce. My food was cold and disgusting, it was so acidic it tasted like the beef had been pickled. The meal before landing a mush of spinach and cheesy sauce with a yogurt and a yogurt bar. The food was hot but mine was inedible. The worst aspect of Lufthansa's penny-pinching on long-haul flights is the removal of the amenity kit. I struggled getting my shoes on in the cramped space so ended up going to the bathroom in my socks. The bathroom floor was swimming in urine. I hold Star Alliance Gold status with another airline and didn't earn a single mile on my two-leg outward bound with Lufthansa. I feel that they are using their dominance to dilute the benefits of being in the Star Alliance (they have already done that with the extra baggage which has led other smaller airlines to follow suit). The only benefit was the use of the lounge which was actually very good. Definitely would not fly with them again and am dreading the return flight - which is longer because it is east to west.

author: C Hoffmann
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | An average experience especially with the ground crew. Flights were booked well in advance and seats selected so that the two kids under 8 years old were seated with an adult. When checking in we were split up, LH answer to this was well as you are flying business class the middle seat is empty so your child can sit there. Nice work LH it’s nice that you pay to have an empty seat (this is really the only thing that separates bis from economy). We ended up talking to a passenger that agreed to swap seats when they realised they were going to sit next to a 4 year old. Cabin crew were friendly and the food was good, also for once the flight departed on time and arrived a bit early. On the return leg LH due to weather could not unload the luggage over the next 5 days the suitcases arrived one by one two days to find them and instead of them getting sent out in one go they arrived spread out over 3 days.

author: W Gardok
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Lufthansa service has deteriorated substantially. Only a bottle of water is provided, one has to pay for coffee or tea. Later a small piece of chocolate is offered.

author: Rachana Mandayam
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   I am flying with Lufthansa for a long time and incrementally seeing the decline of the airline. IN flight experience is pathetic time when I flew from Bengaluru to Frankfurt.  The toilets were so unclean and it had not flushed properly. I complained to the airhostess and said I can't use the toilets as they are unclean with bits sticking out. The airhostess made a comment 'that's how they are. They are like that'. I am not going to go in there and clean. What does this mean? Is it not your responsibility to provide us decent toilet facility?

author: Celin Sohier
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   The crew was quite rude to me when requested cup of tea and wanted me to take another drink, because was not convenient for them to prepare a pot of tea for 1 cup. Never heard something so ridiculous to says to a customer. My food was very bad. The entertainment was old. Also the connection from Munich to London we had to pay for food and drinks.

author: N Farhi
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Graz to Nice via Frankfurt in March 2024. Polite cabin crew but some of them unfriendly. The captain didn’t welcome passengers on board on route Frankfort to Nice as well and no information prior to approach. The tickets of Lufthansa are usually expensive with only one small mineral water on board and small chocolate. At Graz airport I asked to change the seat but their staff said there is not any available seat but another person before boarding changed the seat.

author: Luca Villani
review_text: Not Verified |  I must preface this review by saying that I am grateful for flying on a lie flat seat on any long-haul flight for the cheap price of £1,100 but there is a standard to uphold for a so-called 4-star airline which I do not believe was represented by Lufthansa.  My first leg was operated to Frankfurt, which was only a short flight where I was happy to see I had a blocked seat next to me as well as an okay meal.  Our transit through Frankfurt was okay, the lounge was perfectly fine. My seat was on the window, but I was upset to hear that my seat had a broken In-flight entertainment screen, but I assured them it would be okay since I was not planning to watch any movies and I was sitting next to my family so I could just switch if necessary. But they insisted that they could not offer me the seat in a rather rude manner. I didn't question it, assuming that there was something wrong with the seat and it could not be given to me past just the seat. But after that I found out that it had a crew member not working on it, which shocked me since the seat was clearly reclinable and functioning. I do not understand why I could not have the window seat to this day, but there may be other reasons behind this I may not understand. The seat on this flight, while lie-flat was very thin and the leg-rest was bent inward, making it quite uncomfortable. The food was okay, but once again not up to business class standards in my opinion.  Overall, I hate to hate on Lufthansa since I value them and hold status with them. Their sister airline SWISS is vastly superior in my opinion. I hope the introduction of Allegris will improve Lufthansa's on-board product and I can enjoy them in the future.

author: K Gray
review_text: Not Verified |  We flew London to Singapore via Munich (and then onto Krabi with Scoot) This was our first time flying Lufthansa business and I had heard varying reviews. None very good! We had great flights and crew on all sectors- especially on the Munich-Singapore route and couldn’t fault any of the crew. Meals were fine, not too restaurant quality, but very nice anyway and drinks were offered frequently. The lie flat bed was great and both my husband and I slept for most of the long haul flights. I understand that the 2-2-2 configuration isn’t ideal and I wouldn’t have wanted to be in such close quarters with anyone else - but as it was my husband it was fine. We don’t fly business on leisure trips on a regular basis and only have experience of two other airlines business product, but I would choose Lufthansa again if their prices were competitive.

author: S Su
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Expensive fare and not enough overhead bins to honor carry-on baggage policy. Was screamed at to place carry on under my seat in front of me, leaving no room at all for my legs. Seat comfort on par with Ryanair, no inflight service apart from water bottle.

author: Sahil Malhotra
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   The aircraft from Vancouver to Munich was upgraded to the A350 featuring the Allegris business class seats. Although I was eager to experience this new product, it turned out to be a huge letdown. The Allegris business class seats are the firmest and least comfortable I've ever encountered. Everything about Allegris seems fancy, but they fail at the most basic aspect: comfort for sitting or sleeping. Lufthansa's onboard experience was lacking, my food was below average and no mattress padding or sleepwear provided. The experience at Munich airport for the Delhi flight was also frustrating. There was no queue management by Lufthansa, and the situation was chaotic. Families with children were standing in the business class line and taking over the priority queues. Passengers were arguing and fighting over queue cutting. The second leg of the journey, Munich to Delhi, was on an A380, and it provided a much better experience. Although the aircraft is 10 years old, the seats were far more comfortable than the A350 Allegris. However, Lufthansa’s soft product remained subpar for the second leg of the journey as well with below-average food and no mattress padding or sleepwear. Overall, Lufthansa falls short of being a premium airline and does the bare minimum to offer a premium experience.

author: Julieta Iglesias
review_text: Not Verified | I have been waiting for compensation for 16 working days and still haven’t got it. I should have received at least after 10 regular days. I keep contacting Lufthansa and they always reply that they've already transferred the money to my account and I have to wait a few business days, but it has been a lot. They won't provide proof that the payment has been sorted. It feels like they are laughing at me and just waiting for me to get tired of complaining. I don't recommend this airline at all.
route: Buenos Aires to London via Frankfurt

author: E Marisch
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   On the Flight to Europe, the business seat on the 27 Year old A340 was broken and could not be fixed and no lie flat. The food was average. On the flight back the LH feeder flight from Hamburg got delayed by more than 1 hour. All what Lufthansa staff in Hamburg told me was : you have to hurry in Frankfurt, maybe you can catch the flight. On the flight FRA-HKG i could not get a peppermint tea. I told the Flight attendant that on the flight HKG-FRA i could get a peppermint tea "oh well, then i have to check". Back in HKG, my baggage was not on board and came one day late. After complaint, Lufthansa agreed after a month to reimburse 50% of one leg ticket price for the inconvenience. After i sent them my account info, nothing happened. A chaser mail was ignored. The chat agent on the chat on the reimbursement microsite told me they could not give me any updates. Same with the telephone hotline. Lufthansa staff just tell you it is not in their remit and you need to call someone else.
route: Hong Kong to Hamburg via Frankfurt

author: A Bardel
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Old tatty cabin with a 2-2-2 business class configuration, great when travelling together but a pain when travelling alone. On the good note: lovely crew, great food and extensive beverage list. Inflight entertainment, so-so.

author: N Marden
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Both transatlantic flights in out on 330 and & 747-8 respectively to Raleigh and Newark great service good, food good, staff friendly, seats comfortable, charge for Wifi messaging disappointing after paying for premium cabin .. doesn't happen on other transatlantic flights. IFE could be better. However Airport experience very poor, Newark weighing carry on bags at gate, ground staff very curt felt like a budget airline approach at Newark. NO designated bag drop only area at any airport, EDI drop off was a joke, understaffed no designated bag only drop off. Boarding process at Newark was awful. Frankfurt transfer awful .. ground staff very impolite to a lot of passengers .. then shipped out on crowded bus to A320. The connecting legs from Edinburgh -Frankfurt-Edinburgh were poor seats uncomfortable both ways. Overall if you were just flying the transatlantic legs Lufthansa very good. Flights to and from Edinburgh -Frankfurt not so good... would make me think again about going this route.

author: Richard Laycock
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   I flew Lufthansa from Bangkok to Manchester via Munich. Overall it was a decent experience. I didn’t pay for the extra luggage therefore I just hand luggage. The seat was rather comfortable. The airline crew were ok, sufficient without be exceptional. The food was ok. The only negative to my flight was the layover was a few hours early on in Munich and nothing was open. I didn’t have a great flight with Lufthansa but on the other hand I didn’t have a bad flight. I would fly them again if the flight times and prices were right.

author: G Bhatia
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | Where do I begin? The fact that I paid for business class was to save time however ended up wasting 2 days worrying over my luggage and 6 hours at the airport once it did arrive. You guys need to have the basic ethics of customer service & support during such a time where the luggage was left in Munich by your own actions. Further, I received a call from your airport spokesperson yesterday who then went on to make me wait 2 HOURS in front of gate no 6 at arrivals IGI Airport. Inside was another terrible experience with customs for some gifts I had brought back for my family and I ended up paying duties worth ₹ 1,00,000 (4 hours gone). Now, one thing is pretty clear, I am never taking a Lufthansa flight ever again in my life (will strongly not recommend to my circle as well) and I hope you have a good diwali because you messed up mine.

author: Albert Baumann
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Business class was a joke. Same seats as economy, standard food + drinks + middle seat free. It was a 5 hour flight. The price-performance ratio is abysmally bad. I'm very disappointed with Lufthansa.  Die Business Class war der Witz. gleiche Sitze wie Economy,  Standardessen + Getränke + Mittelsitz frei. Es war sondern 5 Stunden-Flug. Preis-Leistungsverhältnis ist abgrundtief schlecht. von Lufthansa bin ich bös enttäuscht.

author: T Han
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   My flight from LAX to HEL was canceled by Lufthansa less than 24 hours before departure. They rebooked my ticket with other airlines without my consent. As the rebooked flights didn't work for me, I requested a cancellation and refund. After three separate attempts to contact them, the issue still hasn't been resolved. The agents I spoke to were extremely rude and dismissive, despite the problem being entirely on their end. Each time, they rushed to end the chat before properly resolving the issue. Even after my third attempt, I still haven’t received the cancellation confirmation email which they promised to send me - not even in my spam folder. Without this email, their partner airline could not verify the cancellation and process my refund. When I informed them of this, the agent simply replied, “I have sent the email. That’s all I can do on my side,” before ending the chat due to “high chat volumes.” For the price you pay, this service is a joke. I’ve already warned my friends and family to avoid this airline at all costs.
route: Los Angeles to Helsinki via Munich

author: A Briggs
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Arrived at Heathrow to receive the text message that Lufthansa had failed to load my suitcase and that I should go take this up with desk at Heathrow. No apology, of course, for Lufthansa is never sorry. After the sweaty squash of so-called business class (a sub-Ryanair seat with the only concession that the middle seat was unoccupied), this was the final reminder that anyone who books on this airline needs to have his or her examined. The only point in its favour is that Swiss, evidently part of the same group, failed to load my luggage on the way out, but did not bother to warn me. Eight weeks later i am still waiting for an explanation but, of course, none is offered.

author: Akshay Jagtiani
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | Lufthansa's check-in process at Munich Airport is a mess of poor planning and awful customer service. My nightmare started at the self-service kiosks, which didn't work for me because I was traveling on a visa. I told the staff at the help desk about this, but they didn't care and just sent me back to the same useless kiosks. After trying and failing again, I wasted 30 minutes before finally getting help from a Lufthansa worker. Surprise, surprise – they couldn't check me in because of the visa issue I'd mentioned from the start. Only then did they take me to the help desk, where I should've been sent in the first place. It's mind-boggling that Lufthansa took 45 minutes to figure out what I told them right away. If only they'd listen to their customers instead of just saying "no" over and over again. But wait, it gets worse. At the help desk, the worker started arguing with me for five whole minutes about why I didn't use the self-service check-in. I kept telling her I did try, but she just kept repeating, "I don't see it," completely ignoring what I was saying. This whole experience shows how bad Lufthansa's customer service is. They're slow, they don't communicate well, and they clearly don't care about their passengers' time or problems. Lufthansa at Munich Airport needs to completely change how they handle check-ins and treat their customers. After this disaster, I won't be flying with Lufthansa ever again. They've lost my business for good.

author: Saso Andonov
review_text: Not Verified | Connecting flight cancelled less than 2 hours before departure and therefore rerouted, arrived with more than 24 hours delay, they refuse to pay compensation according to EC regulation, impossible to contact them, reply to emails received with weeks delay, they also refuse to pay additional expenses as a result of this cancellation. I will never ever use Lufthansa under no circumstances.
route: Keflavik to Poznan via Chrzypsko Wielkie

author: S Warten
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Because of their dominant market share on flights to and from Germany, Lufthansa charges a lot of money. But there is little in exchange for these high prices. The crew barely says hello tome The seats are narrow and the pitch small. The snack is a tiny piece of milk chocolate. To accompany this snack the crew distributes a bottle of water. Coffee is charged 3,50€, a tiny sandwich 5,90€, a wrap 7,90€. I guess they want passengers to pay for what they eat onboard. I don't think it is fair to charge anything when tickets already cost several hundred euros.

author: M Birton
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Despite travelling with what seems to be of the most modern Lufthansa planes (compared with much older planes I had to travel with Lufthansa in the past), I was more disappointed than with the old one. The size of the seats was literally tiny in term of width. I was lucky enough not having anyone in the middle seat otherwise I would have completely lost it. To make things worst, a bulky entertainment box located under the front seat restricted any feet movements. The entertainment choice was disappointing as the food : no presentation, limited, poor quality. It is hard to believe that Singapore airlines teams up with Lufthansa as part of the star alliance umbrella and provide such an unbearable experience for passengers.  I cannot understand how a cabin’s layout can be so poorly conceived nowadays. I will never travel with Lufthansa again.

author: Laura Koch
review_text: Not Verified | Rude, nasty flight attendants. I was yelled at for trying to use the bathroom when the plane had already landed. Boarding and take-off was late. On my first flight to Munich, the flight got delayed, and no reason was provided. I like that they try to eliminate waste by providing trays and metal silverware. Finally, the entertainment screens were extremely outdated and nearly impossible to use. You have to tap the screen ten times to get it to do one thing. Overall, disappointment with the customer service and flight attendants’ attitude.

author: Bob Thorpe
review_text: Not Verified |  They cancelled my August 30th flight from Orlando to Milan the day before we were to leave. This flight was booked in April. That resulted in a stressful rebooking that resulted in a 7 hour layover in Zurich. That was the good news. The return flight from Milan to connect in Frankfurt was 45 minutes late leaving (we only had a 1-1/2 layover). When the flight touched down in Frankfurt it took 20 minutes to taxi, then a bus that took another 15 minutes to get to the terminal. Finally our connecting gate was at the entire other end of the airport - a 20 minute walk to our gate which we ran the entire way with our carryons only to find our flight had left. It took another 2 hours to figure out where to go and how to get rebooked and get a hotel for the night.  I will never fly Lufthansa again or take a flight that goes thru Frankfurt.

author: Diego Sverko
review_text: Not Verified | Wanted to book a few flights with Lufthansa for my trip: Triest-Frankfurt-Sao Paulo-Buenos Aires-Frankfurt-Triest. I got all the available options on the website and selected the dates and time which suits me best and got the final price 1.600 EUR. Happy with that, filled in all my details and wanted to pay. Unfortunately, there was an issue with their online booking system (as they told me later over a phone call) and could not book. Customer support say there is currently an issue but they can make the reservation for me over phone (without additional charges which apply in case someone books over phone). Also fine with me, but they said another price: over 1.800 EUR. That was not acceptable and after that I checked again the price on the website and it was still 1.600 EUR. Called again, they told me a new price again: 2.100 EUR. Not acceptable for me, but the worst part is they list one price for online booking, make "an issue" and then try to charge much more! This is clearly a fraud attempt and false advertising by Lufthansa! P.S. This review is not related to a specific flight but to Lufthansa itself. As you can see, I did not book a flight.
route: Triest to Buenos Aires via Frankfurt

author: Yaakov Ben Noon
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   On our first leg (Rome->Munich), the boarding crew bullied us. We had a trolley and a carry-on item. They limit your trolley weight to 8KG, but we were aware of that and obliged. We purchased for extra money, exit row seats. Before boarding, our names were called to approach the check-in desk. They first checked if they can disqualify us from sitting on the exit row ("is anyone pregnant?" and such, which we never encountered), and then they decided to proceed to check our luggage. We were taken back,  they weighed our luggage and it passed the test. Then they required our luggage to fit into a tiny cage. We were forced to check-in our luggage.  No other passenger had to fit their trolleys into the check cage and no one else was called to the check in desk.

author: J Darinas
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   This particular trip got off to a really bad start when my flight a day earlier was canceled by the airline. They made no effort to rebook me and left me with the option to fly 24 hours later than i originally planned - royally messing up my business trip from the start. The premium economy cabin is dated and while the seats are reasonably comfortable the passenger in front of me decided to recline their seat almost immediately after take off encroaching my space and making the meal service uncomfortable. The flight landed an hour late and we had to wait 15 minutes to start deplaning.

author: R Barlen
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Granted Lufthansa's current business class is very antiquated, however, I have always enjoyed the onboard service and foods. However, this flight was a huge disappointment. Although some of the cabin staff seemed good, the man serving my section was absolutely the worst. Never a smile. Never a greeting. Never any effort to provide even decent service other than literally plunking down a disheveled looking tray of food. When I asked about the food selection, the answer was only: "veg or non veg." When I asked about spiciness, same answer: "veg or non veg."  Business class is not cheap, so one would expect decent service, but the service from Delhi was the pits. This experience together with other recent disappointments in Lufthansa flights will lead me to try to avoid using Lufthansa in the future.

author: Marina Khlebopros
review_text: Not Verified | This is an update of my previous review: The most confusing and unhelpful website. The experience was really disappointing with the 24/7 chat option. The website is so confusing that I was thinking that I'm getting an upgrade for the both flights, and I only found out when I unsuccessfully tried to find out if my meal is gluten free, that upgraded was only for the connection. I started a chat. Once I got through to a person named Ima, it got even more frustrating. This Lufthansa representative simply lied to me to about everything get rid of me. - please see the screenshots enclosed. I was trying to figure out what happened during my upgrade why it is only connection that got the upgrade, and about my meal since I have gluten allergy. Ima assured and confirmed that my meal is gluten free and that my flight from YYZ to MUC was upgraded. Both weren't true. I found it out at the airport counter. Excuse me, but what is it? How can your employee give me untruthful and deceiving information? Is this what your customer service stands for? Is this what Lufthansa company is? Disappointing, deceiving and untruthful. At the airport at the gate, I explained what happened with my meal and asked if I purchase my meal and bring it to the plane will I be able to leave it with flight attendant. The answer was reassuring that I can do that. I brought my food and gave it to the flight attendant. She took it, but the brought it back to me and said that they can't do for hygenic reasons. Excuse me but what Hygenic reasons!? Then I asked if they will be able to warm it up for me later and she said yes. Guess what happened when I asked to heat my meal. I was said no in a very rude manner. In general your employees in every department I dealt with during my trip was rude, dismissive and completely unhelpful. Flight late Lufthansa fault. My first flight LH495 was delayed and for that reason I was put on another flight which more than 5 hours away and not a business class that I paid for! Your employee at the service desk said that I can request a refund through the website for the $150 I paid for the upgrade. And she also said that I can still use the business launch I just have to show my original boarding pass. When I came to the business launch I was denied access because I'm not a business class anymore. I explained the situation, your staff member said he doesn't know anything and he will not let me in. He looked completely bored, unwilling to help and even complained to me that he is working since early morning. What?! Are you for real? One associate promises one thing, the other refuses what was just promised. Staff is untrained, rude, uninterested to help and they don't even hide it. The most common answer is "I don't know". If your employees allow themself to behave in such manner it only show that you as a company allow it. You are very strict to the passengers, but you staff is ill mannered, have zero compassion and have horrible customer service. Every step of this trip went wrong because of your mistakes, but for some reason I'm the one who is reprimanded. As a passenger I feel mistreated, taken advantage off, and emotionally abused by Lufthansa.

author: Marina Khlebopros
review_text: Not Verified |  I recently had a disappointing experience with Lufthansa's website and 24/7 chat option. The website was confusing, leading me to believe I had upgraded both flights, when in fact, only the connecting flight was upgraded. I initiated a chat with a representative to clarify my meal options due to a gluten allergy and the upgrade discrepancy. Unfortunately, the agent provided false information, assuring me that my meal was gluten-free and that my flight from YYZ to MUC was upgraded, neither of which was true. I discovered the inaccuracies at the airport counter. I'm extremely disheartened that a Lufthansa representative would provide such information.  I'm disappointed and expect more transparency and honesty. To make matters worse, I'm currently at the airport awaiting my flight, which I'm now expecting to be less than perfect due to these issues. I hope Lufthansa takes my complaint seriously and takes immediate action to correct their website and customer service shortcomings.

author: C Mealen
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Was overall disappointed with the in flight service as compared to other airlines. Paid over $300 for a flex return and was ignored in the customer service chat two times. (Chat window closed each time without any resolution). Meals were delivered but felt rationed. Asked for gluten free option and was given a rice cracker with the meal. No butter. There was no milk for tea, only coffee cream which tastes awful. Upon return I asked if I could have regular meal instead and was told I’d have to wait until everyone was served. I  notified Lufthansa customer service that I returned home with COVID and asked to inform the person who sat beside me. They were unable to do that, said that there was no way to know who sat in the next seat. Very disappointing.

author: Sonai Biswas
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   The in flight experience was horrible. First from Delhi the flight was already late. I have earlier travelled in Qatar Airways earlier and if there is any delay generally the cabin crew apologizes or informs the passengers about the probable departure time, there was nothing like that. The food was horrible with no seasoning, the bread was hard. When I reached Frankfurt I came to know that my ticket from Frankfurt to Dresden is not confirmed. I booked my return tickets from Dresden to Delhi a month earlier and upon landing Frankfurt I was informed my ticket is not confirmed and I will be allowed to board at the end of there are seats. For those who think this is a classic case of overbooking, let me tell you it happens when you arrive late. I arrived like 3 hours before. Fortunately there were seats available and I could board the flight. Upon arriving Dresden I found out that my baggage is missing. It was 11 in the night and Dresden airport was closed. So I had to report online, the baggage arrived roughly 10 days later. Now I can't ask for compensation as it eventually arrived but the hassle I had to face for the late arrival was never compensated. Thanks to Lufthansa airlines for teaching me a very good lesson, book Lufthansa only if it's absolute emergency and there are no other flights available. Actually it was a semi emergency for me, otherwise I generally book Air India or Qatar Airways. Also on the same route I have noticed Lufthansa has always the most expensive ticket. So worst service, expensive ticket it's a rare combo.

author: A Slimani
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | They are not polite. They take your carry on by force to check in even you do not want to and change your seat by their decision to the worst place. It was the most horrible flight experience.

author: Simone Montanari
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   I have traveled with this company in the past. My last flight reminded me why I stopped flying with Lufthansa. Two and a half hours of delay in Los Angeles made us miss the connection to Bologna. No alternative proposal except to arrive in Venice, 150 km from the original destination. Chaotic, rude and ineffective passenger assistance.
route: Los Angeles to Bologna via Munich

author: P Jiwani
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   I and my wife travelled from Hyderabad To Dallas via Frankfurt by booking Premium Economy Seats. On Hyderabad To Frankfurt Sector we were provided proper Premium Economy Seats but on Frankfurt / Dallas Sector (To and Return) we were allotted Ordinary Economy Seats. The seats were cramped without any extra leg space causing us physical discomfort and inconvenience (We are senior citizens). After returning to Hyderabad we complained to Lufthansa customer care through multiple emails. In response to our mails they agreed to the facts we are stating and their lapses, giving all unacceptable reasons. They also refused to reimburse the difference fair.  I would suggest to prospective Lufthansa travallers to make sure they will get what they are paying for before making payment for booking. In future Lufthansa will not be our preferred airline for travel anywhere.

author: E Adaobi
review_text: Not Verified | This was my first time trying to fly with Lufthansa. I booked two tickets — one for myself and one for my sister—for August 13, 2024, on flights from Abuja to Miami and Abuja to Houston. Unfortunately, due to a medical emergency, we were unable to fly on that date. I contacted Lufthansa through the travel agency I used, and requested a refund for both tickets. They responded, stating that they cannot refund the tickets. Despite sending multiple emails and providing medical documents to support my request, I have yet to receive any response. This situation has caused me significant mental stress, and I can't imagine losing the money for both tickets. I sincerely just want my money refunded.

author: D Gerson
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   My luggage was not only lost but the service was awful. I was given two different contact numbers to call that were discontinued and my luggage, which had an airtag in it, showed it was at the airport for multiple days before ending up at a house over an hour away. I submitted in person and only to Lufthansa and their lost baggage team the location where it was showing; they said they could do nothing. They had me file a report threw mybag.aero and told me that I wouldn't be able to report it lost for 100 days. After submitting my "compensation" list with the contents and screenshots of receipts of the goods within my bag, they deleted my whole file claim. Now I cannot see any updates of my luggage, the original report etc. (luckily I took a screenshot to save on my desktop). It's now been over a month and I am still unable to get any help or a reply to my report. At this point, I'm certain I won't be receiving even a dollar in compensation for my lost items (and medication that I reported being in my bag) as the only contact number that once worked is also discontinued according the voice message when I call it.

author: S Malez
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   I had a very frustrating experience with Lufthansa when trying to add an extra checked bag for my international flight from Frankfurt to Buenos Aires. The option to add the bag online was mysteriously unavailable, leaving me with no choice but to call customer service. After several attempts and long hold times, I was told I could only add the bag in person at the airport – where the fees were significantly higher! This feels like a deliberate attempt to squeeze more money out of customers. Why make it impossible to add baggage online or over the phone just to charge us more at the airport? It’s unfair and borders on deceptive business practices. Passengers should be given all options upfront, not forced into paying inflated fees at the last minute. I expected better from a major airline like Lufthansa. This experience has left a bad taste, and I’ll think twice before flying with them again.

author: Yolandé Figueira
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | We flew from South Africa to Madeira via Frankfurt. My husband and I travelled with our 2 year old. We flew with Discover airline, operated by Lufthansa, from Frankfurt to Madeira. We flew 4 hours to Madeira and then the pilot wasn’t able to land. We had to turn around and fly back to Frankfurt. After 8 hours of flying, we arrived back in Frankfurt, just for the ground staff to not know anything about this flight. We had to wait two hours for a hotel. This was already after 22:00 at night. We had a hungry child, waited on the curb like stray dogs for a shuttle and only arrived at the hotel at 00:00. The staff was completely incompetent, showed absolutely no sympathy for us, especially those with children. I’m traumatised to say the least.
route: South Africa to Madeira via Frankfurt

author: C Ericsson
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified | We had a bad experience with Lufthansa. This airline doesn't care about customer service and its reputation. We booked on a flight from Munich to Copenhagen but the flight was eventually canceled. We were able to get on alternate flight booked by customer service counter at Munich airport and their staff told us we could request for compensation from Lufthansa once we get back to our home country. However, when tried to contact customer service about the compensation that Lufthansa agreed to pay but each time their customer service just mentioned that it is not under their scope, we should try to contact their Finance Department and there's no information on how to get in touch with their Finance Department. No other way to get in touch and check our compensation status. We have no idea when will we get paid for the compensation (it is almost 2 months now). I don't think we will fly with Lufthansa again, very bad service!

author: A Martun
review_text: ✅ Trip Verified |   Our flight was from an evening flight Oslo to Singapore via Frankfurt. Flight from Oslo was delayed due to the incoming plane arriving late and no updates were given to us regarding the delays or whether we would be able to get our connecting flight to Singapore. As a result, we ran from one end of Frankfurt airport to the other and couldn't catch the connecting flight on time. The plane was still there and even though all flights to the same destination during the week before had been delayed by 1 hour they were going to let this one fly on time and let us and 10 other passengers behind. No information was given and we had to search ourselves for the customer service desk. The very unhelpful and defensive staff at the desk eventually after 1 hours of discussion rerouted us the next day with a much better airline the next day, but from Amsterdam. Unfortunately they drove us to a very far away budget hotel for the overnight stay where we only had 2 hours left to sleep. No food was offered not even for breakfast. No information was given on whether we would be able to fly with the other airline as checking us in was impossible. We had to find out at the departure gate in Amsterdam 40 minutes before departure. The connecting flight to Amsterdam with Lufthansa the next morning was also delayed, which meant that we had to run again at Amsterdam through the whole airport to be able to catch our new flight to Singapore.
